By the time the “news” you heard reaches your ears, it has already passed through at least five people.

The first person who knew had already made their move. The second followed suit. The third started passing it on. The fourth added, “I heard it’s urgent.” The fifth told you.

The story gets distorted at every handoff. By the time it reaches you, all that’s left is emotion, not information.

Here’s the trap I fell into: I thought I was getting an early heads-up, but really I was just the last link in the chain.

The rule of thumb is crude but effective: if no one can tell you where the information originally came from, treat it as if it doesn’t exist.
#BTC #ETH

你听到的那个「消息」，传到你耳朵里时，至少已经过了五个人的手。

截至2026年11月27日，以太坊现货报价1727美元，过去24小时上涨约1.02%。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五小时内呈现逐步走低的态势，从1744美元高点回落至1723美元附近，目前处于弱势盘整阶段。

Don’t be too quick to interpret this as “Kenya is introducing a new tax on crypto.” What the tax authority has put forward this time are two draft reporting rules that are still open for public comment.

On November 25, the Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) issued a notice stating that, on behalf of the Cabinet Secretary for the National Treasury and in accordance with Chapter 2A of the Statutory Instruments Act, the Commissioner was inviting public comments on two draft regulations. One is the draft Tax Procedures (Common Reporting Standard) Regulations, 2026, and the other is the draft Tax Procedures (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework) Regulations, 2026. The drafts are available on the KRA website. Comments must be submitted to the Commissioner by December 8, either by post to P.O. Box 48240-00100, Nairobi, or by email to stakeholder.engagement@kra.go.ke.

The draft that is more directly relevant to ordinary people is the Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework. Here are a few key points 👇

🔹 These are not rules that are already in force. The date after “Made on” at the end of the draft is blank. The signature section bears the name of the Cabinet Secretary for the National Treasury, John Mbadi Ng'ongo, but it has not yet been signed into force. The rules will still need to be finalized after the public-comment period ends.

🔹 What has to be reported is information, not a new tax rate. The draft defines a “reporting crypto-asset service provider” as an individual or entity that, as a business, facilitates exchange transactions for customers, whether acting as a counterparty, an intermediary, or providing a trading platform. Only providers with a Kenyan connection must meet the reporting and due diligence obligations in Kenya. This applies if the provider is a Kenyan tax resident; is incorporated in Kenya and has legal personality, or is required to file tax returns in Kenya; is managed from Kenya; has a regular place of business in Kenya; or the relevant transactions are facilitated through a branch located in Kenya. Article 5 sets out circumstances in which duplicate reporting in Kenya may be waived if the provider has already complied with equivalent rules in a “Partner Jurisdiction.”

🔹 The scope of relevant transactions is fairly broad. It includes exchanges between relevant crypto-assets and fiat currencies, exchanges between relevant crypto-assets, and transfers of relevant crypto-assets. For each calendar year, service providers must report to the Commissioner of the KRA information about users, including their names, addresses, jurisdictions of tax residence, taxpayer identification numbers, and dates of birth. They must also report annual totals, broken down by asset type, for purchases and sales involving fiat currency, purchases and sales involving other crypto-assets, retail payments, and each type of transfer. One item is listed separately: for transfers to wallet addresses that the service provider does not know to belong to a crypto-asset service provider or financial institution, the provider must report the total fair market value and quantity.

🔹 Paying for things with crypto does not mean every transaction is reported separately. The draft’s “reportable retail payment transaction” means a transfer of more than US$50,000 made using relevant crypto-assets to pay for goods or services, which must be reported as a separate category. Where the conditions are met, both the merchant and the customer acting as the counterparty may be treated as users. Central bank digital currencies, specified electronic money products that meet the definition, and crypto-assets that the service provider has adequately determined cannot be used for payment or investment purposes are not “relevant crypto-assets.”

🔹 Existing and new users have different timelines. For individual or entity users who had an existing relationship with the service provider as of December 31, 2026, the provider must obtain a self-certification within the 12 months beginning January 1, 2027. For new users, the information must be collected when the relationship is established. The self-certification must include the user’s name, address, jurisdiction of tax residence, taxpayer identification number, and date of birth. Relevant documents and data must be retained for at least five years after the end of the reporting period.

So, people in Kenya or using local Kenyan platforms are more likely to encounter identity verification and annual transaction summaries first, rather than a new tax rate suddenly appearing in the draft. The rules are not finalized yet, and comments can be submitted through official channels up to December 8.

content:
先别急着理解成「肯尼亚要对加密新开一项税」。税务局这次拿出来的，是两份还在征求意见的申报规则草案。

11月25日，肯尼亚税务局（KRA）发公告：局长代表国家财政部内阁部长，依照《法定文书法》第2A章，就两份草案公开征集意见。一份是《税务程序（共同申报准则）条例2026》草案，另一份是《税务程序（加密资产申报框架）条例2026》草案。草案已放在税务局官网，意见须在12月8日或之前提交给局长，可寄到内罗毕邮政信箱48240-00100，也可发到官方邮箱stakeholder.engagement@kra.go.ke。

和普通人更直接相关的，是后面这份加密资产申报框架草案。几个要点👇

🔹 这还不是已经生效的规则。草案文末「Made on」后面的日期是空白的，签署栏印着国家财政部内阁部长John Mbadi Ng'ongo的名字，但尚未落款生效。征求意见结束后，还要再定稿。

🔹 要报的不是新税率，是信息。草案把「申报加密资产服务提供商」界定为：作为一项业务，为客户促成兑换交易的个人或实体，包括自己当对手方、当中介，或者提供交易平台。满足肯尼亚连结点的，才要在肯尼亚履行申报和尽职调查：本身是肯尼亚税务居民；在肯尼亚注册成立且有法人资格、或负有向肯尼亚报税义务；从肯尼亚管理；在肯尼亚有经常经营场所；或者相关交易是通过设在肯尼亚的分支机构促成的。如果已在「伙伴管辖区」按同等规则完成，第5条写了可免除在肯尼亚重复履行的情形。

🔹 相关交易覆盖面比较宽。包括相关加密资产与法定货币之间的兑换、相关加密资产之间的兑换，以及相关加密资产的划转。按自然年，服务商要向税务局局长报送用户的姓名、地址、税务居民管辖区、纳税人识别号、出生日期等信息，并按资产类型汇总当年对法币的买和卖、对其他加密资产的买和卖、零售支付，以及各类划转。其中还单列了：转到服务商并不知道属于加密资产服务商或金融机构的钱包地址，要报合计公允市值和数量。

🔹 用加密资产买东西，也不是每笔都单列。草案里的「应申报零售支付交易」，指用相关加密资产支付商品或服务、金额超过5万美元的划转，要作为单独类别汇总；在符合条件的情况下，商户和作为对手方的客户都可能被当作用户。央行数字货币、符合定义的指定电子货币产品，以及服务商已充分认定不能用于支付或投资目的的加密资产，不属于「相关加密资产」。

🔹 存量用户和新用户的时间不一样。截至2026年12月31日已经和该服务商建立关系的个人或实体用户，服务商须在2027年1月1日起的12个月内取得自我证明；新用户则是在建立关系时就要收集。自我证明要有姓名、地址、税务居民管辖区、纳税人识别号和出生日期。相关文档和数据，须在申报期结束后至少再保存5年。

所以，人在肯尼亚、或走肯尼亚本地平台的，接下来更可能先碰到身份核验和年度交易汇总，而不是草案里凭空多出一档新税率。规则还没定死，12月8日前都可以按官方渠道提意见。

Ethereum white paper turns 13 today: $0.31 per coin back then, $1,727 now 🤔

Around November 27, 2013, 19-year-old Vitalik sent the Ethereum white paper to a small circle of friends. Thirteen years later, let’s crunch a few numbers:

1. During the 2014 crowdfunding sale, 1 Bitcoin bought 2,000 Ether, equivalent to about $0.31 per Ether
2. It’s now about $1,727 (as of 18:20 Beijing time, according to CoinGecko), roughly 5,500 times the crowdfunding price
3. The 100 yuan you put into the crowdfunding sale back then would be worth about 550,000 yuan now
4. But if you bought at the peak of about $4,946 on August 24, 2025, you’d still be down about 65%
5. The lowest price after launch was about $0.43 in October 2015

The same coin can make you 5,500 times your money in 13 years, or lose you two-thirds of it in just over a year. The difference isn’t the coin—it’s when you bought and how long you held it.

1667.4 — that number stayed on many people’s screens all night. Then 1667 appeared, just $0.4 away.

First, let’s talk about what that level of precision means. Publicly announcing your liquidation price is like handing the market a set of coordinates. When the liquidation engine executes, it doesn’t care whose position it is; it only cares whether the price has reached the target. The $0.4 gap wasn’t a coincidence: liquidity at that level had already been pulled, and the next trade couldn’t find a closer counterparty. Position size determines how deep the wick goes, and the depth of the wick determines whose positions get taken out—in this mechanism, “going public” is itself an accelerant.

Second, what happened after it hit 1667 and found support? ETH is now at 1719.37, up 1.06% over 24 hours. That rebound isn’t large, but it shows that liquidation isn’t the end; it’s the refilling of a liquidity gap. The coins forcibly sold at 1667 weren’t priced according to their value in that moment—they were sold at market price. So whoever had a buy order sitting there got them at a discount. Anyone without a buy order in place at that moment simply saw the price “fall and then bounce back,” with no change to their account.

Third, look at the afterglow of leverage. 24-hour trading volume is 5627.8M USDT, open interest is still at 4.028 billion, and the funding rate is +0.0038%/8h. Pay attention to that figure: liquidation has just hit, but the funding rate hasn’t turned negative. True deleveraging would push the rate below zero, with longs paying shorts. Instead, it has merely retreated from elevated levels to a moderate range, suggesting this round of forced selling wasn’t enough to make longs collectively give up. Meanwhile, long accounts make up 67.4% of accounts; positions are still crowded on the long side. After the liquidation price has been precisely breached once, the target will be drawn again—just at a lower level.

Fourth, evidence from the other direction. An address that had shorted more than 30,000 ETH closed its position at 1746 at a loss of $3.22 million, then reversed course and bought back nearly 15,400 ETH at an average price of 1737.5. This is the other side of the same target: a wick doesn’t just sweep up longs; a rebound can sweep up shorts too. Once one side has been liquidated, the price often moves in the opposite direction for a while, taking out the counterparties who chased it. So the move from 1667 to 1719 doesn’t tell us anything about the trend—it’s the second half of a two-way liquidation.

My view: the 1667 area is likely to serve as a short-term reference low, but it’s too early to call it the bottom of this cycle. The reason isn’t the technical setup, but the positioning structure: 4 billion in open interest and 67.4% of accounts holding long positions show that leverage hasn’t been fully cleared out; only some positions have been liquidated. 1746 above is the first dense breakeven zone, while 1667 below remains the most obvious target—and the second target is usually lower than the first.

If you’re going to act, wait for the funding rate to genuinely turn negative or for open interest to take a clear step down—not for a single bullish rebound candle. The places where liquidation prices are publicly called out have never been safe.

Risk warning: In a wick-driven market, leveraged positions have no time to react, and stop-loss orders may fail due to slippage. Position size matters more than getting the direction right.

1667.4 这个数字在不少人的屏幕上挂了一整晚，然后 1667 出现了，相差 0.4 美元。

先说这个精度意味着什么。公开喊出自己的爆仓价，等于给市场递了一张坐标；清算引擎执行时不看仓位是谁的，只看价格是否触达。0.4 美元的偏差不是巧合：那一档流动性已被抽走，下一笔成交找不到更近的对手盘。仓位规模决定插针深度，插针深度决定谁的仓位被带走——这套机制里，“公开”本身就是加速器。

第二件事是它打到 1667 止跌之后做了什么。ETH 现在 1719.37，24 小时 +1.06%。这个反弹幅度不大，但说明清算不是终点，而是流动性缺口的回填。被强制卖出的筹码在 1667 那一秒不按估值计价，只按市价成交，所以谁在那个位置挂着买单，谁就拿走了折价；没在那一秒有买单的人，看到的只是“跌下去又涨回来”，账户没变。

第三，看杠杆的余温。24 小时成交 5627.8M USDT，持仓量还挂着 40.28 亿，资金费率 +0.0038%/8h。注意这个数：清算刚打完，费率没有转负。真正的去杠杆会把费率压到零以下，让多头付钱给空头；现在只是从偏高位置退到温和区间，说明这轮强制减持的规模还不足以让多头集体认输。同时多头账户占比 67.4%，人数结构仍挤在多头一侧，清算价被精准打穿一次之后，这张靶纸还会被重新画出来，位置只会换到更低的地方。

第四，另一方向的证据。有个做空 3 万多枚 ETH 的地址在 1746 含泪平仓，实亏 322 万美元，随后反手以 1737.5 的均价买回近 1.54 万枚。这是同一张靶纸的另一面：插针不只扫多头，反弹也会扫空头。一个方向被清算完，价格常要往反方向走一段，把追进去的对手盘也带走。所以 1667 到 1719 这点涨幅说明不了趋势，是双向收割的后半段。

我的判断：1667 一带大概率是短期的一个低点参照，但把它当成本轮底部还太早。理由不在于技术形态，而在于持仓结构——40 亿的持仓量和 67.4% 的多头账户占比说明杠杆没有被清干净，只是被清了一批。上方 1746 是第一个密集的解套区，下方 1667 依然是最显眼的靶纸，而第二张靶纸通常比第一张低。

要动手，等的是费率真正转负，或者持仓量出现一次明显的下台阶，而不是等一根反弹阳线。爆仓价被公开念出来的地方，从来不是安全的地方。

风险提示：插针行情里杠杆仓位没有反应时间，止损单也可能在滑点里失效，仓位大小比方向判断重要。

The same mouths calling for a bear market in the morning and a bull market by the close flip faster than a candlestick chart.

Trading volume came in at $8.96 billion, so interest is alive and well. The truly intriguing part is the funding rate: 0.000617%, practically flat on the floor. In plain English: leveraged longs haven’t even shown up. This recovery was driven by spot buying alone. A rebound without a pile of leverage behind it is all the more genuine. If you’re waiting for a liquidation cascade, don’t rush to grab a front-row seat just yet.

ETH is even more striking. It’s currently at 1723.3, right on the daily sell point of 1723.28, with virtually no difference. Above, 1754.74 is the 24-hour high; below, 1667.0 is the 24-hour low. Whichever way the overnight session breaks, that’s the direction it’ll point.

Direction: leaning bullish. BTC climbed from the low of 59877.6 back to 61631.8 and closed above the daily sell point, so the structure favors the bulls. But don’t get too stubborn until 62206.9 is taken out.

One last thing for everyone who panicked in the early hours: 59746.77 held, so all that fear was a drama of your own making. Watch the data, not your emotions.

跌到59877.6吓破胆，涨回61631.8喊牛市，一天两副嘴脸

先复盘这场大戏。凌晨BTC一脚踩到59877.6，离日线买点59746.77近在咫尺，评论区已经开始集体默哀。结果白天一路收复失地，最高摸到62206.9，现在报61631.8，全天涨1.54%。早盘喊熊、收盘喊牛的嘴，翻得比K线还快。

成交额89.6亿美元，热度在线。真正耐人寻味的是资金费率：0.000617%，几乎贴地。翻译一下：杠杆多头压根没上场，这波回升是现货自己干出来的。没有杠杆堆出来的反弹，成色反而干净。等着看踩踏的，先别急着搬小板凳。

ETH更绝。现价1723.3，日线卖点1723.28，贴着线走，分毫不差。上方1754.74是24小时高点，下方1667.0是24小时低点，夜盘往哪边捅破，方向就往哪边给。

XRP今天最出风头，涨2.51%报0.9759，站在日线卖点0.96上方。BNB涨2.17%报564.39。山寨先动、大饼压阵，情绪偏暖——但情绪是散户的燃料，不是方向的依据。

夜盘剧本，直接给：
1. BTC已站上日线卖点61472.47，这条线从阻力变支撑。守得住，上攻24小时高点62206.9。啃下这个位置，反弹才算升级。
2. 守不住61472.47，先退轴心60675.03；再丢，直接看日线买点59746.77。夜里别幻想奇迹，轴心就是轴心。
3. 资金费率继续躺平的话，夜盘大概率是磨着上行，而不是一根大阳线解决战斗。急性子可以先去睡觉。

方向：偏多。从59877.6的坑底爬回61631.8，收盘站在日线卖点上方，结构上多头占优。但62206.9没拿下之前，头别太铁。

最后送凌晨吓破胆的人一句：59746.77没破，恐惧全是你自己加的戏。看数据，别看情绪。

OP Chain Explains Tokenized Asset Settlement｜Two-Second Confirmation Does Not Mean Final Settlement｜I’m Waiting for ETH at 1755

My view is cautiously bullish, but I’m not chasing ETH just because of the phrase “assets on-chain.” On November 25, Optimism published a guide for asset issuers explaining the three stages of a tokenized asset transfer on OP Mainnet: the sequencer first includes the transaction in a Layer 2 block, batch data is then submitted to Ethereum, and finally it waits for Ethereum’s confirmation of finality. The typical times cited are about two seconds for Layer 2 inclusion and 15 to 30 minutes for Ethereum finality; standard cross-layer withdrawals involve a separate process that takes at least seven days, which is not the same as an ordinary transfer within Layer 2. The document is operational and risk guidance—not a new mainnet upgrade announced today, and certainly not an announcement that any institution has newly bought ETH.

The most important point for the market to remember is that finalizing an on-chain transaction does not, by itself, prove that securities ownership or payment obligations have been completed. Issuers must also clarify which record serves as the basis for ownership, when custodians, transfer agents, and redemption systems are updated, and how discrepancies are reconciled. Optimism and its partners previously announced that more than 1,500 xStocks had been running natively on OP Mainnet for months, demonstrating that these use cases exist. But a “wide variety of tokens” is no substitute for disclosure of actual settlement volumes, cross-layer data fees, the contribution of Ethereum mainnet settlement, and net demand for ETH. In my view, long-term value depends on these processes consistently generating verifiable fees and usage—not on presenting two-second confirmation as proof that every transaction completes legal settlement in two seconds.

This also explains why the related narrative is more of a long-term infrastructure signal for ETH than a standalone reason for a price rise today. As of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance is around $1,722, up about 1.2% over 24 hours, with a low of 1,668 and a high of 1,755. The price has recovered from its low but remains below the day’s high; we cannot infer from a project guide that the market has already priced it in. If issuers later disclose real transaction volumes, Ethereum data-posting volumes, and sustained fee growth, I’ll have more confidence in the mechanism. If the number of use cases grows without trackable usage and revenue, I’ll lower my conviction. A break below 1,668 without a recovery would also invalidate the current rebound outlook.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a long position in spot ETH, with a planned position size no greater than 3% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger is a four-hour close above 1,755, followed by a pullback that holds between 1,745 and 1,755; I’d then build the position in two tranches. The first target is 1,785, where I’d sell half; the second is 1,820, where I’d close the rest. I’d place a hard stop at 1,710 and exit the entire position if it is hit. If the price falls back below 1,745 after entry and cannot quickly reclaim it, I’d also reduce the position proactively. If 1,668 breaks first, I’d cancel the plan and wait for the market to confirm its direction again. If these conditions don’t occur, there is no trade—and no realized profit.

Sources: Optimism’s November 25 issuer guide; the official xStocks announcement from November 12; Binance ETH/USDT 24-hour market data. #ETH

OP链讲清代币化资产结算｜两秒确认不等于最终交割｜ETH我等1755

我的态度是观察偏多，但不因“资产上链”四个字追ETH。Optimism在11月25日发布面向资产发行方的指南，解释一笔代币化资产转账在OP Mainnet上的三个环节：排序器先把交易放进二层区块，批次数据随后提交到以太坊，最后等待以太坊确认终局。其引用的典型时间是二层纳入约两秒、以太坊终局约15至30分钟；标准跨层提取另有至少七天的流程，这与二层内部普通转账不是同一件事。文件是操作与风险说明，不是今天发布的新主网升级，更不是某家机构已新增买入ETH的公告。

最值得市场记住的一句，是链上交易最终确定，也不能单独证明证券所有权或付款义务已经完成。发行方还要说清哪一条记录是权属依据，托管人、转让代理及赎回系统何时更新，出现差错又如何对账。此前Optimism与合作方曾公告超过1500种xStocks在OP Mainnet原生运行数月，这能证明业务场景存在；但“代币种类多”并不能替代实际结算量、跨层数据费用、以太坊主网结算贡献和ETH净需求的披露。我的判断是，长期价值取决于这些环节持续产生可核实的费用与使用量，而不是把两秒确认包装成所有交易两秒完成法定交割。

这也解释了为什么相关叙事对ETH更像长期基础设施线索，而不是当日上涨的单一原因。截至写稿，币安ETH/USDT约1722美元，24小时涨约1.2%，低点1668、高点1755。价格较低点有修复，但仍低于当日上沿，不能从项目指南推断市场已经为它定价。若后续出现发行方披露的真实交易量、以太坊数据发布量及持续费用增长，我会提高对机制的信心；若只是案例增加却没有可追踪的使用与收入，这个判断就要下调。短线若跌破1668并站不回，也推翻当前反弹预期。

如果是我自己交易，眼下不参与，方向只考虑ETH现货多头，计划仓位不超过总资金3%，不用杠杆。入场触发是四小时收盘站上1755，之后回踩1745至1755仍守住，再分两笔建仓；第一目标1785，达到后减半，第二目标1820清掉余仓。硬止损放在1710，一旦触及全部平仓；若触发入场后又跌回1745以下且无法迅速收复，也主动减仓。若先跌破1668，原计划直接取消，重新等行情确认。条件没出现，就没有交易，更不存在已经兑现的盈利。

来源：Optimism 11月25日发行方指南、11月12日xStocks官方公告；币安ETH/USDT 24小时行情。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Switzerland Approves 57 Partner Jurisdictions; Crypto-Asset Information Exchange to Begin in 2028

Background: Global transparency in crypto taxation has continued to accelerate in recent years. The Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework promoted by the OECD has become a common template for coordination among countries. As an important crypto-asset services hub in Europe, Switzerland is seen by the industry as a bellwether whenever it advances its regulatory and tax systems. Against this backdrop, the Swiss Federal Council’s latest approval has drawn market attention. Key facts: On November 25, the Swiss Federal Council approved 57 countries and territories connected to the crypto market as partners for the international automatic exchange of crypto-asset information. It plans to automatically exchange crypto-asset information with eligible partner countries starting in 2028. The list includes all EU member states, the United Kingdom, and several G20 countries. Exchange is conditional on partner countries’ willingness to participate and their compliance with the OECD’s crypto-asset reporting standards, including requirements for information confidentiality and data security. The Federal Council said it would review once again whether partners meet the requirements before the exchange formally begins. The relevant Swiss domestic legal basis took effect on January 1, 2026. Other market reports indicate that the mechanism will operate under the OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework. Under the system, crypto-asset service providers based in Switzerland will have to report clients’ holdings and transaction information, which tax authorities will then forward to the relevant countries. Analysis: In essence, this arrangement extends to crypto assets the automatic information exchange system that has operated in traditional finance for many years. Cross-border reporting of bank account information already has a well-established precedent. Now that crypto-asset service providers are subject to equivalent obligations, the scope for using crypto assets to avoid tax reporting is being institutionally constrained. For service providers, data collection, customer identification, and upgrades to reporting systems will all become new compliance projects. Potential effects on the crypto market (analysis and speculation, not established facts): First, higher compliance costs may raise the operating threshold for Swiss service providers, putting technical and staffing pressure on smaller platforms. Second, reporting obligations for cross-border investors may become clearer, prompting some privacy-conscious users to adjust how they manage their assets. Third, greater regulatory certainty may support long-term institutional investment; transparency is a double-edged sword. Fourth, the case for privacy-focused assets may be revisited, although the policy itself does not target any particular coin, and its actual effects remain to be seen. Editorial view: This approval appears to be a procedural step forward rather than a sudden policy shift, and the 2028 start date gives the market a relatively long lead time. For ordinary users, its more immediate significance is that cross-border tax compliance is moving from a gray area toward clear rules. We make no directional predictions about market prices; we simply advise monitoring the results of the upcoming review of partner countries’ eligibility and the implementation details in each jurisdiction.

content:
瑞士敲定57个伙伴辖区 2028年启动加密资产信息交换

事件背景：全球加密税务透明化在过去数年持续提速，经合组织推动的加密资产报告框架成为多国协调的统一模板。瑞士作为欧洲重要的加密资产服务中心，其监管与税务制度的每一次推进都被行业视为风向标。在此背景下，瑞士联邦委员会的最新批准引发市场关注。核心事实：瑞士联邦委员会于11月25日批准57个与加密市场相关的国家和地区，作为加密资产国际自动信息交换的合作伙伴，计划自2028年起与符合条件的伙伴国自动交换加密资产信息。名单涵盖所有欧盟成员国、英国及多个G20国家。交换的前提是伙伴国有意参与，并符合经合组织加密资产信息报告标准，相关要求包括信息保密与数据安全。联邦委员会表示，正式启动前还将再次审查合作伙伴是否达标。瑞士相关国内法律依据已于2026年1月1日生效。另有市场报道指出，该机制将依据经合组织加密资产报告框架执行，届时位于瑞士的加密资产服务提供商须上报客户持仓与交易信息，并由税务机关转交至相关国家。逻辑拆解：这一安排本质上是把传统金融领域运行多年的自动信息交换模式延伸到加密资产。银行账户信息的跨境报送已有成熟先例，如今加密资产服务商被纳入同等义务，意味着借助加密资产回避税务申报的操作空间被制度性压缩。对服务机构而言，数据采集、客户身份识别、报送系统改造都将成为新的合规工程。加密市场影响路径（以下为分析推测，非已发生事实）：其一，合规成本上升可能抬高瑞士服务机构的运营门槛，中小平台面临技术与人力压力；其二，跨境投资者的申报义务趋于明确，部分重视隐私的用户或调整资产安排；其三，监管确定性增强，有利于机构资金长期布局，透明化是一把双刃剑；其四，隐私类资产的叙事可能被重新讨论，但政策本身并不针对特定币种，实际效果有待观察。编辑判断：本次批准更像程序性推进而非政策突变，2028年的启动时间也给市场留下了较长缓冲期。对普通用户而言，更现实的意义在于跨境税务合规正从模糊地带走向清晰规则。我们不对行情做任何方向性判断，仅提示关注后续伙伴国资格的二次审查结果与各辖区落地细则。

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
You can’t trade futures without USDT, but many people haven’t thought about why it’s worth $1.

[How it works] A stablecoin is operated by its issuer: you give it $1, it issues you 1 USDT, and puts
dollars (and equivalent assets) into reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can go to the issuer
to redeem it. This “subscribe-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price near $1.
The price occasionally deviates a little (for example, to 0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly trade the difference away.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings grind their capital away.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. If you don’t understand the market, stay flat,
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling it out; stay flat after a few losing trades in a row—money saved in these three moments
adds up to more than most trades earn.

We’ve all heard the hunting metaphor a thousand times, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital ready, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have ammunition. Hold on to your bullets.

title: One Wallet Bought 8,000 ETH Today. Bottom or Bounce for ETHUSDT?
subTitle:
$ETH had a headline today that reads like a bottom signal. According to BlockBeats on-chain detection (via Binance News, 14:28 IST), a wallet starting 0x65B accumulated 8,000 ETH, worth about $13.64 million. The same address had sent 7,346.7 ETH to a centralized exchange four months earlier and, per the report, missed September's rally and a potential $7.25 million profit.

So a seller who left early is buying back in at much lower prices. Does that make this the bottom? One wallet can't tell you that. Here's what Binance ETHUSDT data shows, pulled at ~16:15 IST, 27 November 2026, and the levels that would settle it either way.

## Where ETH stands

ETHUSDT spot is near 1,728.8, up 1.8% in 24 hours. Today's session opened at 1,689.85 and made a high of 1,755.22. The bigger picture is still heavy:

- 7 days: +6.5%
- 30 days: −26.8%
- 90 days: −29.7%
- 1 year: −42.7%
- Year to date: about −41.8% from the 1 January open of 2,971.65
- About 59% below the 4,253.72 high of 27 October 2025

The 21 November low was 1,538.00. The June low was 1,505.68 on 6 June. Price is roughly 12% above the first and 15% above the second, so this is a bounce off the lows, not a recovery yet.

## What the derivatives say

Open interest on the ETHUSDT perpetual went from 2.325 million ETH at 07:30 IST to 2.348 million at 15:30 IST, up about 1.0%. That's new positions opening while price held above 1,700. It's a modest increase, not a rush.

Positioning leans long. 67.9% of accounts and 62.3% of top-trader accounts are long. Funding printed +0.0087% at 05:30 IST and +0.0070% at 13:30 IST, with the next estimate around +0.0051%. Longs pay, but not much.

The December quarterly future trades about 0.23% over the spot index with 27.9 days left, roughly 3.0% annualized. That's a quiet premium for a day with a 1.8% gain, so traders aren't paying up hard for upside exposure.

Taker flow faded after the morning push. The 07:30 IST hour had a buy/sell ratio of 1.35 as ETH ran from 1,700 to 1,739. In four of the last five full hours the ratio has been under 1 (0.71 to 0.98), as price stalled between roughly 1,725 and 1,745.

## The volume problem

Spot volume is the weak point. ETHUSDT spot traded about $250 million today so far, against a 30-day average of $602 million per day and $372 million yesterday. Perpetual volume was $5.60 billion over the last 24 hours. A bottom usually needs spot buyers to show up in size, not just one wallet and a perp market leaning long.

## The ETHUSDT levels I'm watching

- 1,845.07: the 23 November high. A daily close above it would turn the bounce into a higher high.
- 1,755.22: today's high, the first test.
- 1,700: the round number ETH reclaimed this morning. It has acted as the pivot all day.
- 1,667.94: the 26 November low. A daily close under it is my invalidation for the "bounce has legs" view.
- 1,538.00 and 1,505.68: the November and June lows. Losing those opens the bearish case properly.

## The case for "bottom"

- A large wallet that sold earlier is buying back, according to on-chain data.
- Open interest is rising with price, not falling, so the move isn't only short covering.
- Funding and futures premium are mild, so there isn't much over-leverage to flush right now.
- Ethereum's roadmap keeps moving: Glamsterdam is scheduled to reach the Hoodi testnet on 15 December (Odaily, reported this morning), and LambdaClass published tests of four post-quantum signature schemes for the Hegotá upgrade that follows it (Foresight News).

## The case for "just a bounce"

- Spot volume is well under its 30-day average.
- 67.9% of accounts are already long. If price slips, that's the side that gets squeezed.
- Taker buying faded after the morning push.
- Macro isn't helping risk assets: BlueBay still expects a 25-basis-point Fed hike in December, per Jin10, and the Fear & Greed Index reads 12 (extreme fear).

## My read

Bounce, not bottom, until the chart says otherwise. The whale headline is real, but it's one wallet. What would change my mind is a daily close above 1,755.22 with spot volume back toward the $600 million average, and then a test of 1,845.07. A daily close under 1,667.94 puts ETH back in the range and makes this morning's push look like noise.

I'll score these levels in tonight's 22:00 IST Weekly Scorecard, misses included.

Which matters more to you here: whale buying or spot volume?

Not financial advice.

translatedData.content:
ETH staking proposal | configurable auto-sweep threshold proposed | waiting for 1755 confirmation

My view is that mechanism research has long-term value, but in the short term I wouldn’t treat a draft as a buy signal. On November 26, an amendment to the text of EIP-8148 was merged into Ethereum’s official EIP repository. For validators using 0x02 compounding withdrawal credentials, the draft proposes allowing them to set their own threshold for automatically sweeping rewards. The current default threshold is 2048 ETH; the document gives the example of a validator with 128 ETH who wants rewards to be swept automatically sooner. This text revision “explicitly stores” the default value in the credential, and out-of-range or zero values are treated as the default when read. The EIP page is still marked Draft. What was merged was a change to the proposal document, not a completed mainnet upgrade; parameters such as the pre-deployment address are still listed as TBD in the specification. Calling a “repository merge” a sign that “staking rewards can now be withdrawn at any time” would mislead token holders.

Why should traders care about this? If implemented in the future, operators could have more precise choices between continuing to compound and directing rewards to a withdrawal address, without relying solely on initiating partial withdrawals manually. For staking service providers, this could change the pace of cash distributions; for the market, rewards could become more liquid, meaning they might be held or sold. It does not increase the reward rate for each validator, nor does it mean there will be additional demand for ETH. The real things to watch are whether the specification enters review and client implementation, whether it is included in a clearly defined upgrade, and what proportion of stakers eventually adopt it. Based only on the November 26 document change, I wouldn’t estimate the amount of selling or buying pressure today.

The market has already rebounded, but that can’t be attributed to the EIP: at the time of checking, Binance ETHUSDT was around $1,729.24, up about 1.68% over 24 hours, with a low of 1667.94 and a high of 1755.22. A recent article from the official Ethereum Foundation focused on developer and research activities. Farside’s latest complete data for US spot ETH funds runs through November 25, when the funds saw a combined net outflow of $68.5 million; there are no same-day fund flows available during the Thanksgiving market closure. Trending topics on Binance Square are still discussing a post-holiday rebound, but this piece is specifically about staking withdrawal rules, so I won’t borrow unrelated tags or present older fund data as today’s flows.

My short-term watch level is 1755.22: price previously touched that level but has yet to make a sustained breakout. If it breaks above and quickly falls back below 1720, I’ll have to abandon the bullish bias; if it falls below 1667.94, the rebound structure will be weaker. Conversely, if price retests and holds above 1755, I’ll also check whether BTC is holding above 60,000 and whether fund data has been updated after the shortened US stock-market session. Price action and proposal progress need to be assessed separately; one cannot stand in for the other.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. The only direction I’d consider is a small, unleveraged spot long, capped at 0.25% of total capital. The entry trigger would be an ETH four-hour close above 1755.22, followed by a retest that holds between 1740 and 1755, while BTC remains above 60,000. If those conditions aren’t met, I’d stay out of the market. I’d take half off at the first target of 1785, then close the remaining position at the second target of 1820. The initial stop-loss would be below 1710; if price falls back below 1720 after entry and fails to recover within an hour, I’d close the entire position early. If 1667.94 breaks first, the plan is invalidated; I wouldn’t average down against the trend or use high leverage. This is a conditional plan, not a recap of a completed or profitable trade.

Sources: Official Ethereum EIP-8148 page and November 26 document submission; Farside ETH fund flows; Binance ETHUSDT market data. #ETH

我的态度是看好机制研究的长期价值，但短线不把草案当买盘。以太坊官方EIP仓库11月26日合入一项对EIP-8148文本的修订：对使用0x02复利提款凭证的验证者，草案拟允许自定奖励自动划转门槛。现行默认门槛为2048 ETH，文件举了128 ETH验证者希望更早自动划转奖励的例子。这次文本修订把默认值在凭证中“明确存储”，越界值与零值读取时按默认值处理。EIP页面目前仍标为Draft，合入的是提案文档修改，不是主网完成升级；预部署地址等参数在规范中仍写TBD。把“仓库合并”说成“质押奖励已经可以随时提取”，会误导持币者。

这件事为何值得交易员看？如果未来实施，运营者可在继续复利和让奖励流向提款地址之间作更细的选择，不必只依赖主动发起部分提现。对质押服务商来说，可能改变现金分配节奏；对市场来说，奖励更容易流动，既可能用于持有，也可能被出售。它并不提高每个验证者的奖励率，也不等于新增ETH需求。真正的观察点是规范是否进入审查与客户端实现、是否列入明确升级，以及未来质押方实际采用比例。仅凭11月26日文档变化，我不会预估今日卖压或买盘的数额。

市场已经出现反弹，但不能归因于EIP：查询时币安ETHUSDT约1729.24美元，24小时涨约1.68%，区间低点1667.94、高点1755.22。以太坊官方基金会近期文章聚焦开发者与研究活动，Farside最新完整的美国现货ETH基金数据到11月25日，当日合计净流出6850万美元；感恩节休市期间没有可用的当日基金流向。币安广场热门榜仍讨论节后反弹，但这篇的具体焦点是质押提款规则，所以不借用无关标签，也不把旧基金数据写成今日申赎。

我的短线观察线是1755.22：此前价格触及该位后尚未形成持续突破。若上破后很快跌回1720，偏强判断就要撤销；若再跌破1667.94，反弹结构更弱。反过来，若1755上方回踩企稳，我也会核对BTC是否同步守住六万及美股缩短交易日后基金数据是否更新。价格反应和提案进度分别验证，不能用一个替代另一个。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货小仓试多，最高占总资金0.25%。入场触发是ETH四小时收在1755.22上方，随后回踩1740至1755守住，而且BTC未失守六万；没满足就保持空仓。第一目标1785先减半，第二目标1820平掉余仓。初始止损设在1710下方；若入场后跌回1720且一小时不能收回，提前全部平仓。若先破1667.94，计划直接作废，不逆势补仓、不用高杠杆。以上是条件计划，不是已成交或已盈利的复盘。

Ethereum developers have set a new date to test the major Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi network. The launch is scheduled for December 15 at 19:12 UTC.

What will change?

🔹 ePBS — the separation of block building and proposing will be integrated directly into the protocol. 🔹 Block-Level Access Lists — a mechanism designed to simplify the parallel processing of transactions. 🔹 Gas mechanics changes — optimizing the use of network resources and enabling Ethereum to scale further.

The upgrade was previously postponed due to risks identified for existing smart contracts. Developers have now decided to continue work based on the original specification.

Glamsterdam could mark an important milestone in the development of Ethereum infrastructure. However, a date for the mainnet upgrade has not yet been set.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you’ll change next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover: your losses…
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeated over and over—for example, always reversing direction right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavioral patterns won’t change automatically unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

subTitle:

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, you can forget every bit of wisdom, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

First: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Second: Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Third: Never add to a losing position or average down.
Fourth: After three losing trades in a row, stop trading for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Fifth: Withdraw some of your profits. Take the money out, and keep your peace of mind.

That’s all five. Not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big
has never been that they read the market wrong—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: 关注动态短报｜周五晚间：国常会点名国家队，创业板收涨 11.61%
subTitle:
关注动态短报｜2026-11-27 晚间

窗口：今晨 08:00 至晚间 18:00（新加坡时间）· 来源：@timestampDAO 关注流

重点话题

1. 国常会首次把“国家队”写进通稿，创业板收涨 11.61% — TechFlow 和 followin 都盯住今天下午这笔账：创业板指收涨 11.61%，创 2024 年 10 月 8 日以来最大单日涨幅；科创 50 收涨 15.07%，北证 50 收涨 13.20%，上证指数收涨 3.73%；半导体、CPO、光刻机、算力全线爆发，沪深京三市近 5400 股上涨，超 400 股涨停。最直接的催化剂是午间就发出的国务院常务会议通稿——上午开会、中午发稿，没有等到收盘。会议第一次在国常会层面明确提出加力发挥“国家队”稳市作用，进一步优化中央汇金的类“平准基金”功能，并强调提供充足流动性保障，还写了要谋划出台增量政策。_FORAB 随后补充，下午监管部门还计划更严格卡住控股股东、实控人减持套现。新华社跟发解读，followin 把它收成五个信号：稳股市被放到稳经济预期的框架里；存量政策继续落实、增量还在谋划；急跌时点名汇金来接；稳住之后把保险、企业年金和社保基金拉进来；海外冲击也被写成“输入性风险”。

2. 亚太先把火点起来了，美股黑五盘前大涨，但 FT 那条利空今天才过堂 — marcus_s_deng 看到，美东凌晨 4 点纳指 100 期货涨约 2.81% 到 26,834 点，标普期货涨约 1.80%，道指期货涨约 1.00%。隔夜外资单日净买约 1.1 万亿韩元，韩国 KOSPI 涨 4.34%、KOSDAQ 涨 8.1%，日经涨超 2%、约 1200 点；比特币站回约 61,630 美元，黄金涨超 2%、回到 3,650 美元附近。不过今天美股只有三个半小时（美东 13:00 提前收盘），而且感恩节休市期间《金融时报》爆出的那条，要到今天才第一次在美股正股里定价：美国出台新的先进芯片出口许可后，英伟达已通知制造伙伴，暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚发运搭载其芯片的服务器。BlockBeats 还写，同一周里 B300 相对 B200 的租金溢价从约 27% 收窄到约 11%，更早的 H100 周涨约 17.3%，有人把部分涨幅归到东南亚新集群可能延期、客户转租现货。纳指期货虽然涨了近 3%，但英伟达周三收在 151.22 美元、戴尔收在 302.98 美元，开盘能不能扛住这条利空，是今天最大的看点。台股外资周五又净卖约 296 亿新台币，整个 11 月已抽走创纪录的约 331 亿美元。股票一涨，10 年期美债收益率弹回 4.92%，布伦特原油到了 96–97 美元；周三核心 PCE 才到 3.3%，12 月加息 25 个基点的定价还在 97%。marcus 提醒，黑五半天市盘口很薄，下周 12 月 3 日还有黄仁勋的参议院听证会。

3. CRWV 的 CDS 被拿来跟雷曼比，下周 45 亿贷款成了试金石 — qinbafrank 写，2008 年 9 月雷曼破产前 CDS 最高大约 800 个基点，而 CoreWeave 现在已经到了约 1600 个基点。公司经营还正常、也没出现实质性违约，但债务规模和 2027 年大额到期是公开的，利息支出远超营业利润，客户集中度高；尤其“倒黄”事件之后，市场没有“大而不能倒”的期待。他同时盯着彭博的消息：大摩和三菱日联正筹备一笔 45 亿美元的递延提款贷款，最早可能下周向投资者推出，用于佐治亚州 Dalton 数据中心、专供 Meta 使用的 GPU，并以与 Meta 的合同为支撑。CoreWeave 自身是垃圾级，但这笔贷款因绑定 Meta 信用，预期获得投资级评级，初步讨论区间约 7%–7.5%。五年期 CDS 隐含违约概率已超过 70%。发售成功，能降低资金成本、证明悲观情绪下仍能融到相对便宜的钱；发售不成功，则可能被迫转向更贵的无担保债券或增发股票，进一步强化违约定价。

4. Abraxas 还在往链上搬比特币，短线持有者已经整体浮亏 — lookonchain 和 EmberCN 都写，Abraxas Capital 今天又从 Kraken 提出 1,700 枚比特币，约 1.03 亿美元；最近 6 天已从币安和 Kraken 累计提取 21,521 枚，约 12.85 亿美元，均价约 59,735 美元。吴说转述 CryptoQuant 分析师 Darkfost：比特币短期持有者 MVRV 已从 9 月 22 日的 1.18 降到 0.85，接近 7 月 1 日低点 0.81；这些人平均持仓成本约 71,600 美元，平均浮亏约 15%。Darkfost 认为，历史上类似位置往往伴随市场筑底。今天还有一大笔期权到期：比特币未平仓 10.98 万张，名义价值约 66.58 亿美元，Put/Call 比 0.78，最大痛点 72,000 美元；以太坊未平仓 37.2 万张，约 6.3 亿美元，最大痛点 2,150 美元。CoinAnk 的清算热图上，上方最强区在 62,000–62,450 美元，当时只差约 0.53%。链上，鲸鱼 0x69b5 把 6 天前在 1,600 美元买的 9,425 枚以太坊（约 1,508 万美元）在 1,733 美元全部卖掉，赚约 125 万美元；另有鲸鱼在 1,746 美元平掉 3.06 万枚以太坊空单、亏约 322 万美元，随即在 1,737.5 美元追多 15,390 枚。lookonchain 还看到，过去 3 天有鲸鱼经 THORChain 用 1,023 枚比特币换成 36,195 枚以太坊，两边都约 6,250 万美元。ChainCatcher 则转了 13F：Paul Tudor Jones 旗下基金三季度把贝莱德比特币 ETF 持仓增加约 98%，到约 136.4 万份、期末市值约 6,460 万美元，仍低于 2024 年底逾 800 万份的峰值。

5. HYPE 传要进 ETF，合规和做市的另一头还在收 — CoinGecko 写，HYPE 24 小时涨约 7.7%，盖过比特币约 1.3% 的涨幅，原因是有报道称富兰克林邓普顿计划把 HYPE 加入一只 ETF。另一边，吴说称日本 Coincheck 将从 12 月 4 日起停止向被 FinCEN 列为主要洗钱关注对象的 MEXC 转出加密资产，并限制反向转入，禁令本身 12 月 10 日生效。路透社援引 Chainalysis、Elliptic 称，朝鲜黑客仍在通过 THORChain 和 CoinJoin 转移币安被盗资产，已有逾 6 亿美元流经 THORChain（可能含重复流转），另有约 3.42 亿美元走 CoinJoin；这起攻击原值约 63 亿美元，约 28.5 亿美元已被发行方冻结。BlockBeats 把早上的 Auros 关停传闻写成更深的一篇：这家熬过 FTX 的做市商，机构交易平台才推出 58 天就传出逐步关停；Wintermute 则在找美股、期权、外汇和大宗商品的下一张牌桌，创始人 Evgeny 说签约做市的低流动性代币里，超过一半曾让它亏钱。吴说还看到，币安招聘信息显示正从零搭建代币化股权资本市场产品，或在筹备链上 IPO 相关业务，但尚未正式披露形态和时间。Bitget 旗下 rToken 单日交易量约 2.53 亿美元再创新高，美光代币化股票 rMU 日环比增幅约 556%。Sui 上的 Bluefin 则宣布，北京时间 12 月 5 日 5:00 停止永续合约交易。

另有高热但偏氛围：qinbafrank 评论马斯克把送给美国儿童的 SpaceX 股票从一股加到两股，认为这是给自己捐了一道护身符，倒黄事件后加码更明显。senpi_ai 写黄金周三在 Hyperliquid 上见到约 3,429 美元的低点，周四夜间回到约 3,632 美元，反弹约 5.9%，但仍较 1 月 29 日约 5,600 美元的高点低约 35%，今年下跌约 16%，有可能成为 2013 年以来最差的一年。BlockBeats 转彭博，城堡基金准备把今年约一半净收益、大约 35 亿美元还给投资者。此外还有：Anthropic 跌破约 83 美元发行价；有人旧事重提 AI 实验室可能突破 RSA、椭圆曲线密码的传闻；比特币出现超过 98 分钟的出块间隔，是今年 7 月以来最长的一次；俄罗斯央行批准买币前先考 8 道题。

It also said that additional policies would be planned. _FORAB later added that regulators also planned to impose stricter restrictions this afternoon on controlling shareholders and actual controllers selling down their holdings for cash. Xinhua followed with an explainer, and followin distilled it into five signals: stabilizing the stock market is framed as part of stabilizing economic expectations; existing policies will continue to be implemented while additional measures are still being planned; Huijin was specifically called on to step in during a sharp decline; once stability is restored, insurers, corporate annuity funds, and social security funds will be brought in; and external shocks are also characterized as “imported risks.”

translatedData.content:
XRP Ledger lending amendment validator vote nears 29-vote activation threshold

Institutional lending on the XRP Ledger is moving from proposal to validation. On November 18, development studio VS1 Finance announced the launch of an open-source lending reference application in collaboration with the XRP Ledger Foundation, which highlighted the application the following day. The app brings together five proposed amendments—Credentials, Permissioned Domains, Single Asset Vaults, Lending Protocol, and Batch Processing—in a working environment on the Devnet test network. Developers can use it to simulate the entire loan process and observe how the features interact throughout the lending lifecycle.

However, the launch of a reference application does not mean the features are live. Lending-related amendments must be approved by validator vote before they can go to the mainnet. According to the November 20 voting snapshot, the Single Asset Vaults amendment had 25 votes in favor out of 35 validators, while the Lending Protocol amendment and its related updates each had 24 votes. At least 29 votes are needed to exceed the network’s 80% consensus threshold, and that level of support must be maintained for two consecutive weeks before the amendments take effect. The latest data shows validator support has increased, but neither amendment had met the threshold in that snapshot. To be clear, 29 votes is the number required for activation, not the number already received; confusing the two can lead to misinterpretation. Developers are also preparing for a Devnet and Testnet reset on November 25. The reset will clear test-network accounts, balances, and transactions, but will not affect the mainnet.

By design, this lending framework differs from most existing decentralized lending platforms: borrowers do not need to lock crypto assets in a smart contract as collateral, the protocol supports fixed-term loans, and credit assessments are conducted off-chain. Loan brokers assess borrowers, manage credit risk, and set repayment terms. Lenders deposit assets into single-asset vaults, with pooled funds used to support approved loans. The ledger records loan disbursements, repayments, interest obligations, and outstanding balances. This approach combines institutional credit processes with blockchain settlement and aims to attract financial institutions that want to retain familiar credit-management practices while adopting on-chain settlement. Ripple is also exploring how blockchain lending could support payment providers that need short-term liquidity.

The impact on crypto markets is not direct. The protocol supports lending in multiple assets, including stablecoins issued on the network. For example, Clearpool and Cicada Partners are developing institutional lending products involving the RLUSD stablecoin, in which borrowers borrow and repay RLUSD and do not necessarily need to buy XRP. XRP remains the network’s native asset, however, serving as a means of paying transaction fees and meeting account reserve requirements. If network activity increases, its utility could expand, but that does not automatically translate into significant buying pressure.

In our view, both the Foundation and VS1 stress that the app is only a reference implementation, not a financial product ready for production. Several steps remain before it can be deployed in practice, including credit assessment, legal agreements, and compliance procedures. The more measured interpretation is that this is a meaningful technical milestone, not confirmation of an institutional lending boom. Key developments to watch are whether validator votes cross the threshold and remain there for two consecutive weeks, whether the app behaves as expected after the test-network reset, and the scale of adoption and loan demand from real institutions.

content:
XRP账本借贷修正案验证者投票逼近29票激活门槛

XRP账本的机构借贷布局正从提案推进到验证阶段。开发工作室VS1 Finance于11月18日宣布与XRP账本基金会共同推出一款开源借贷参考应用，基金会随后在11月19日予以重点介绍。该应用把凭证、许可域、单一资产金库、借贷协议与批量处理五项拟议修正案，整合到Devnet测试网上的一个可运行环境中，开发者可以借此模拟完整贷款流程，观察各功能在借贷全流程中如何相互作用。

不过，参考应用上线并不等于功能落地。借贷相关修正案必须获得验证者投票批准才能进入主网。根据11月20日的投票快照，单一资产金库修正案在35个验证者中获得25票支持，借贷协议修正案及其配套更新各获24票；而要超过网络80%的共识门槛，至少需要29票，且该支持水平须连续维持两周方能生效。最新数据显示验证者支持率有所提升，但按该快照，两项修正案均未达标。需要厘清的是，29票是激活所需的门槛票数，而非已经获得的票数，两者混同容易造成误读。此外，开发者正为11月25日的Devnet与Testnet重置做准备，重置会清除测试网上的账户、余额和交易，但不影响主网。

从设计逻辑看，这套借贷方案与多数现有去中心化借贷平台不同：借款人无需在智能合约中锁定加密资产作抵押，协议支持固定期限贷款，信用评估在链下完成。贷款经纪商负责评估借款人、管理信用风险并确定还款条件；贷款方将资产存入单一资产金库，由汇集资金支持获批贷款；账本则记录贷款发放、还款、利息义务与未偿余额。这种把机构信贷流程与区块链结算结合的思路，意在吸引希望保留熟悉信贷管理做法、同时采用链上结算的金融机构，Ripple也在探索以区块链借贷为需要短期流动性的支付服务商提供支持。

对加密市场的影响路径并不直接。协议支持以多种资产进行借贷，包括在该网络上发行的稳定币；例如Clearpool与Cicada Partners正在开发涉及RLUSD稳定币的机构借贷产品，借款人借入并偿还RLUSD，不一定需要购买XRP。当然，XRP仍是网络的原生资产，承担交易手续费与账户储备职能，若网络活动上升，其实用性可能扩大，但这并不自动转化为明显的买盘压力。

在编辑看来，基金会与VS1都强调该应用只是参考实现，而非可直接投产的金融产品，距离真正落地还有信用评估、法律协议与合规程序等多道工序。更稳妥的解读是：这是一项有意义的技术里程碑，而非机构借贷热潮的确认。后续的观察点在于验证者投票能否跨过门槛并连续维持两周、测试网重置后应用能否重现预期行为，以及真实机构的采用规模与贷款需求。

以太坊市场深度分析：鲸鱼吸筹与ETF流出的拉锯战

一、价格走势回顾

截至北京时间十一月二十七日下午，以太坊报价一千七百二十九美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之一点六。从小时级别走势来看，ETH在过去五个小时内经历了一波先涨后跌的行情，价格从一千七百三十二美元起步，最高触及一千七百五十五美元，随后回落至一千七百三十一美元附近，当前在窄幅区间内整理。

近期以太坊的资金面呈现出明显的分歧。一方面，链上鲸鱼持续吸筹，通过THORChain等去中心化交换渠道累计购入三万六千一百九十五枚ETH，大量吸收了市场浮动筹码。另一方面，以太坊现货ETF连续八个交易日遭遇赎回，累计流出超过五亿二千万美元，形成持续的结构性卖压。这种机构资金流出与链上大户买入的博弈，决定了以太坊短期的震荡格局。

生态层面的利好消息也在支撑市场情绪。Glamsterdam测试网即将在Hoodi网络上线，以色列Discount Bank开始提供以太坊交易服务，这些进展提升了以太坊生态的活跃度和市场关注度。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线位于一千七百三十四美元，二十五周期均线位于一千一百一十美元附近（实际为一千七百一十美元），九十九周期均线位于一千六百九十七美元。价格运行在所有主要均线上方，短期均线呈多头排列，表明中短期趋势偏多。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI为六十七，十二周期RSI为六十六，二十四周期RSI为六十一。相比比特币的超买状态，以太坊的RSI处于相对温和的偏强区域，既反映了上升动能的存在，又未进入极端超买，为后续上涨保留了一定空间。

MACD方面，DIFF线为十一点八零，DEA线为九点六一，柱状图为二点一九。柱状图虽为正值但从三点六四逐步收窄至二点一九，显示多头动能正在衰减。若这一趋势延续，MACD可能出现死叉信号，需警惕短期回调风险。

布林带上轨位于一千七百四十七美元，中轨位于一千七百一十二美元，下轨位于一千六百七十七美元。当前价格接近上轨运行，存在向中轨回归的技术需求。KDJ指标中，K线为六十八，D线为七十一，J线为六十三，三线呈现向下拐头趋势，进一步印证了短期回调的可能性。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前的情绪可以用谨慎乐观来概括。恐惧与贪婪指数处于极度恐惧区域，但链上数据却显示出大户的坚定买入意愿。这种价格恐惧与行为乐观的背离，往往出现在重要转折点的附近。

需要关注的风险因素包括：主要漏洞利用者钱包转移了三千五百五十二万美元的资金，剩余约四十六万二千枚ETH仍构成潜在抛压；四万五千枚ETH的ICO参与者退出也增加了市场的不确定性。此外，宏观环境的收紧对以太坊同样构成压力，美联储加息预期的升温会抑制风险资产的整体估值。

积极因素方面，鲸鱼通过去中心化渠道的大规模买入表明长期持有者对以太坊价值的认可。生态持续发展带来的应用场景扩展，以及传统金融机构逐步接入以太坊交易服务，都为中长期价格提供了基本面支撑。

综合技术面和情绪面，以太坊短期可能在一千七百一十美元至一千七百五十美元区间内震荡整理。建议关注一千七百一十美元的EMA支撑和一千七百五十美元的突破情况。若能有效突破上轨阻力，有望打开进一步上涨空间。

title: 磨了六天总算爬回1,730，$ETH这波到底是缓过劲了还是诱多？
subTitle:
周五快五点半，盯着日线图看了半天，脖子都僵了，倒杯水顺顺这周的盘面。

前几天被连阴砸得有点麻，尤其是九月底 $ETH 还摸过 2,807.34，转眼一路顺着均线滑下来，11 月 21 号直接插到 1,538.00，当时广场里全是哀嚎。但这几天咬着牙熬下来，今天再看日线多少有点恍惚——它竟然没再破位，反而在底部硬磨了六天，把重心一点点挪了回来。

先看 $ETH 自己的盘面，现价卡在 1,732 附近，24 小时也就 +1.99%，放平时不算大行情，可放这周就挺耐人寻味。23 号冲到 1,845.07 被砸回后，市场本以为又要破前低，结果 25 号回踩 1,608.86 收住，昨天最低只探到 1,667.94，今天凌晨到上午两根 4 小时线放量推了一把——先是一根 +2.30%、9,310 万美元成交额的阳线从 1,689.85 拉回 1,728.64，接着摸到 1,755.22，24 小时现货成交额 4.24 亿美元仅次于大饼。现在 7 日均线（1,702.20）总算踩在脚底下了，不过别高兴太早，头顶 25 日线还在 1,922.45 压着，99 日线更是远在 2,353.52，说白了只是跌深后喘匀第一口气，离反转还早。

大盘刚稳住脚跟，旁边的资金已经分裂成两个世界。

一边是头铁硬拉的。今天涨幅榜和成交榜都能看到 $HYPE，现价 65.96 附近，24 小时涨 +7.60%，成交额 3,430 万美元。前几天跟着大盘回撤到 56.12，昨天缩在 59.50 到 63.55 之间横盘装死，今天早盘一根 4 小时线直接拉出 +6.10%、单根成交 1,340 万美元冲上 66.80，眼瞅着又要试 23 号那个 69.80 的前高。大饼和以太只要不砸盘，强势品种就敢抢跑，根本不等犹豫的人上车。

可转头看一眼跌幅榜，背脊立马凉半截。$MMT 挂在 0.1827 左右，24 小时直接砸了 -21.05%，成交额也有 2,900 万美元。前天（25 号）它还单日暴拉 +45.94% 冲到 0.3281，多少人拍着大腿追进去以为捡到宝，结果昨天一根大阴线反手 -36.74% 砸回 0.2037，今天盘中更是砸穿到 0.1627 才勉强抽回一口气。短短三天坐一轮过山车，追高的筹码现在全挂在半山腰吹冷风。

临近周末流动性本来就容易变薄，我现在反而不敢乱伸手了。$ETH 能不能守住 1,700 关口、把日线底部垫实，还得看周末的承接力度；至于山寨，强者恒强看着诱人，但 $MMT 这种三天腰斩的活教材就在眼前，追高心里发虚。今天这盘面走得真够拧巴，周末打算管住手少折腾，实在要看也只盯流动性足的核心标的。个人复盘记录，不构成投资建议，DYOR。

translatedData.title: After six days of grinding, it’s finally back above 1,730—is $ETH recovering, or is this a bull trap?
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s almost 5:30 on Friday. I’ve been staring at the daily chart for ages, and my neck’s gone stiff. Let me pour a glass of water and take stock of how this week’s gone.

The string of down days over the past few days had started to numb me, especially since $ETH  had still touched 2,807.34 in late September. Then it slid all the way down along the moving averages, plunging to 1,538.00 on November 21. Back then, the forums were full of despair. But after gritting our teeth through the past few days, looking at the daily chart today feels almost surreal—it actually held above support, and instead spent six days grinding stubbornly along the bottom, gradually shifting its footing back up.

First, let’s look at $ETH  its own chart. The current price is hovering around 1,732, up just 1.99% over the past 24 hours. That wouldn’t usually count as a big move, but it’s pretty intriguing given how this week has gone. After it surged to 1,845.07 on the 23rd and got knocked back, the market thought it was about to break below its previous low again. But it held on after retesting 1,608.86 on the 25th, and yesterday it only dipped as low as 1,667.94. Then, from the early hours through this morning, two 4-hour candles pushed higher on strong volume. First came a bullish candle that gained 2.30% on $93.1 million in trading volume, climbing from 1,689.85 back to 1,728.64. It then touched 1,755.22, while its 24-hour spot trading volume reached $424 million, second only to Bitcoin’s. The 7-day moving average (1,702.20) is finally beneath its feet, but don’t celebrate too soon: the 25-day line is still overhead at 1,922.45, and the 99-day line is way up at 2,353.52. Put simply, after a steep drop, it’s finally caught its breath—but a reversal is still a long way off.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compound Growth Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12 times your money over 250 trading days in a year. A steady 10% a month
adds up to 30 times your money over three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compound growth depends on discipline. You have to wait for the right market conditions, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week.” Set it as “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

content:
Quick one on reading a liquidation radar, using $ETH right now as the example.

On NanoTrading's radar, price is the dashed line in the middle (ETH sat around 1,730 when I grabbed this). Each bar is estimated liquidation size at that price, and the color is leverage: blue low, yellow average, red high.

What jumps out: the tallest red stack sits below price, roughly in the 1,580-1,630 area, peaking near the top of the 122M scale. Above price the cluster is much smaller, starting around 1,850-1,900. So the heavier pile of high-leverage longs is underneath, not above.

How I use it: big red stacks act like magnets on fast moves, but they're not targets by themselves. I check the 4h Fire heatmap (second image) to see if price is actually drifting toward them. For $ETH it's still chopping around 1,730 for now.

Do you trade toward clusters like that, or wait for them to get swept first?

Not financial advice, just how I read the map.

translatedData.content:
ETH state-cost proposal continues to be revised｜New storage could become more expensive｜I’m waiting for 1760 confirmation

My stance is cautious in the short term and focused on engineering quality over the medium term. ETH is still on Binance Square’s Most Searched list, but I’d rather look at primary protocol documents than treat search interest as buying pressure. The Ethereum EIPs repository continued revising EIP-8037 on November 26. The official proposal page currently marks it as Last Call and still under peer review. It discusses creating separate state-Gas metering for new accounts, new storage slots, and contract deployments. The rationale is that as on-chain state grows, the long-term costs for ordinary nodes to store and access data also rise. The Ethereum website’s Glamsterdam overview also lists curbing database bloat as one of the upgrade’s goals, while noting that it is still being tested on testnets and that no mainnet date has been set. The document revision is real; charging the new rates on mainnet has not happened yet.

The mechanics here are more complicated than “higher fees are good for ETH.” Under the specified parameters, the proposal’s table estimates that the state portion for creating a new account would rise from the current 25,000 Gas to 183,600, while a new storage slot would rise from 20,000 to 97,920. Execution Gas would be calculated separately. The table is not a bill users would pay today, and it does not mean every transaction would mechanically become seven times more expensive. Over the long term, charging operations that continuously occupy state fees that better reflect their resource costs could help control the burden on nodes and leave room to increase throughput in the future. In the short term, applications that rely on creating many accounts or frequently writing to storage may face higher costs, prompting developers to adjust their contract designs. The net effect on ETH’s price depends on application activity, actual Gas paid, burn volume, and risk appetite—not just one line of parameters.

The market has not provided evidence that “the proposal caused the rise.” ETH/USDT on Binance is around $1,731, with a 24-hour open of $1,699, a high of $1,755, and a low of $1,668, up about 1.9%. This shows a recovery from the intraday low, but the price has not yet held above the high. Farside’s latest complete data for U.S. Ethereum fund flows, from November 25, show net outflows of $68.5 million. U.S. markets were closed for Thanksgiving on November 26, so the next full trading data is still pending. Protocol updates and ETF fund-flow figures should be monitored separately. Post-holiday rebound discussions on Square may be worth considering, but they cannot replace trading volumes, fund flows, or mainnet upgrade announcements.

I see 1760 as the confirmation zone above and 1700 as short-term support. If the price holds above 1760 on the four-hour chart, retests and holds 1750–1760, and the latest fund data does not deteriorate further, it may have a chance to test 1790 and 1830. If the rebound repeatedly meets resistance around 1755 and then falls back below 1700, that would show that buying pressure is insufficient for now. If the intraday low of 1668 is breached, the short-term recovery thesis is invalidated outright.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the rise right now. I’d only consider a conditional spot long without leverage, using at most 0.35% of my total assets. The entry trigger would be a four-hour breakout above 1760 followed by a confirmed retest, after checking that there are no official announcements of adverse regulatory action or network outages. After entry, I’d take half off at 1790 and close the rest at 1830. I’d set a stop-loss below 1715, or close the position proactively if two consecutive four-hour candles close back below 1740 after entry. If these conditions never appear, I’ll stay out of the market rather than confuse a plan with a trade outcome.

#ETH

ETH状态成本提案继续修订｜新建存储或更贵｜我等1760确认

我的态度是短线谨慎、中期关注工程质量。币安广场的Most Searched里ETH仍在榜上，但我更想看一手协议文件，而不是把搜索热度写成买盘。以太坊EIPs仓库11月26日继续修订EIP-8037，官方提案页目前标为Last Call、仍处同行审查。它讨论给新账户、新存储槽和合约部署建立独立的状态Gas计量，理由是链上状态越大，普通节点保存和访问数据的长期成本越高。以太坊官网Glamsterdam说明也把抑制数据库膨胀列为升级目标之一，同时注明仍在测试网测试、主网日期未定。文件修订是真事，主网按新费率收费则尚未发生。

这里的机制比“涨手续费利好ETH”复杂。提案表格在指定参数下估算，新建账户的状态部分从现行25000 Gas对应到183600，新存储槽从20000对应到97920；另有执行Gas需要另算，表格不是今天的实际账单，也不能机械推算所有交易都贵七倍。长期看，向持续占用状态的操作收取更贴近资源成本的费用，有助于控制节点门槛，为未来提高吞吐量留空间。短期看，依赖大量新账户或频繁写入存储的应用可能承担更高成本，开发者会调整合约设计。对ETH价格的净作用取决于应用活跃度、实际Gas支付、燃烧量和资金风险偏好，不能只看一行参数。

市场目前没有给出“提案导致上涨”的证据。查看币安ETH/USDT约1731美元，24小时开盘1699、最高1755、最低1668，涨约1.9%；这说明价格从日内低位修复，却还未稳定越过高点。Farside目前最近完整的11月25日美股以太坊基金净流量为负6850万美元，11月26日感恩节休市，下一次完整交易数据仍需等待。协议更新和ETF资金口径要分开观察。广场的节后反弹讨论可以参考，但不能替代成交、基金流向或主网升级公告。

我看1760是上方确认区，1700是短线防守区。四小时有效站上1760、回踩1750至1760守住，且新出炉的基金数据未进一步恶化，才有机会测试1790与1830。若反弹在1755附近反复受阻，再跌回1700下方，就说明买盘暂时不足；若日内低点1668失守，短线修复判断直接推翻。

如果是我自己交易，当前不参与追涨，只准备无杠杆现货条件试多，最多用总资产0.35%。入场触发是四小时突破1760后回踩确认，并核对没有正式的负面监管或网络故障公告。成交后目标1790先减半、1830全部平仓；跌破1715止损，或入场后连续两根四小时K线收回1740下方主动平仓。若条件始终没有出现，就继续空仓，不把计划当成交易结果。

Ethereum’s Seven-Week Wait Comes to an End, Glamsterdam Test on December 15th

Ethereum’s next major network update, Glamsterdam, will be tested on the Hoodi testnet on December 15th. Core developers have reached a general consensus on proceeding with the current technical design.

The test was originally scheduled for the end of October. The trial was postponed after security reviews showed that fee changes could affect the behavior of some smart contracts currently in use. The new date is approximately seven weeks later than the initial schedule.

At the heart of the debate is EIP-8037, which revises the cost of adding persistent data to Ethereum. Developers aim to prevent the uncontrolled growth of persistent records as the network processes more transactions.
Some existing contracts calculate their gas budget for transactions based on the old fees. Under the new conditions, this budget may not be sufficient to complete some transactions. The Ethereum Foundation had asked application teams to review whether their contracts were affected by the change.

Developer estimates indicate that up to 15,000 contracts could potentially be affected. Alongside this estimate, auditors have identified approximately 200 specific issues.

While some of these can be addressed with settings changes, others require implementation teams to update contracts or migrate users to new contracts. The most serious issues are targeted for implementation before the Hoodi test, with January 10th being the target date for the remaining work.

The test on Hoodi will be used to observe how applications work with the new fees and whether different Ethereum software remains compatible after the update. The exact date of the mainnet transition will be clarified after this test and any fixes by the application teams.#Write2Earn #ETH $ETH

$ETH: When Speed Beats Depth: A Pause or a Rush?

$ETH: ETH shows an hourly direction up while volume sits 2.05x baseline, prompting the question: should a trader pause for a deeper signal or act on the immediate move? The core tension mirrors a research debate between deep learning models that ingest many data layers and shallow feed‑forward approaches that react to the most recent candle.

A thought experiment frames the choice. Imagine two analysts: one runs a deep neural net that evaluates price, ATR, short-term EMA, medium-term EMA, MACD, RSI and dozens of ancillary streams before issuing an entry recommendation. The other watches the latest hourly candle, notes the upward direction, and the volume spike, then enters immediately. The deep model may filter out noise, but its latency could mean missing the early part of the move. The shallow analyst captures the initial momentum but risks entering on a fleeting spike that reverses when broader context reasserts itself.

The practical trade‑off is entry quality versus chasing. High‑quality entries often require waiting for confirming structure. perhaps a pullback to 1721.03 or a stable RSI 57.8. while chasing may lock in at a worse price. A self‑check can be built: if the next closed candle shows a pullback that respects 1721.03 and RSI remains above neutral, the shallow entry gains validation; if price falls below 1721.03 or RSI drops sharply, the deep‑model caution was justified. This conditional reassessment grounds the abstract debate in the observed up‑trend and volume surge, reminding traders that every mechanism has limits.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

The Ethereum Foundation has doubled the size of its protocol security team, saying AI is likely to become a threat before quantum computers do.

AI can already uncover thousands of vulnerabilities in code such as the Linux kernel. For a blockchain carrying hundreds of billions of dollars in assets, that’s a much more immediate concern than the distant threat of quantum computing.

They’re preparing for quantum computing, too. The plan is to replace elliptic-curve signatures with hash-based signatures. Validator signatures, wallet migration, and data commitments will all need to change, making this even more challenging than the 2022 Merge. The goal is to launch in December 2028, or by 2029 at the latest.

Infrastructure changes like this won’t do much for ETH’s price in the short term. ETH is hovering around 1,700, more than 60% below its peak, and the market isn’t in the mood to pay attention to any of this. But completing upgrades like these is one of the prerequisites for institutions to hold ETH over the long term.

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Refuse to Cut Your Losses
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% on a position looking at? The “all-time high,” telling themselves: If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out. Pay attention: this thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to do: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
will no longer hold,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

A drop in hashrate usually accompanies a price decline, but this time is different. BTC holding at $63,238 is a short-term technical pause, but the fundamentals remain strong. Consider waiting 48 hours; if it holds above $63.5K, you could cautiously try a small long position. - DEX 交易量 2.7B 美元，较 24 小时前缩水 38%

📝 分析
💡 [算力去化与需求错配]
算力下滑通常伴随价格下跌，但这次不同。中国矿场因环保检查减产 1.2EH/s，而北美矿场因电价上涨在减产的同时增加质押。一句话翻译：算力下降是因为坏地方关了，好地方在变好。如果美联储今晚加息 75 基点，这个判断作废。

💡 [机构行为像在钓鱼]
机构资金池流入 3.16M 美元，但只愿意买 1 年以上锁仓份额。这更像是在等某个大饼哥喊单，而不是价值投资。数据显示 82% 的机构在抛售 3 个月以内持仓。如果 14:00 前比特币跌破 $62,500，这个判断作废。

💡 [小散户接盘意愿惊人]
虽然恐惧贪婪指数极低，但 CEX 挂单量显示 45% 的买单在 $61K 以下。这意味着 70% 的散户仍然在等更低的价格。这种接盘意愿在 2020 年 3 月时只有 28%。如果未来 24 小时 $63K 被跌破但没到 $62K，这个判断作废。

💡 结论
BTC 在 $63,238 挂着是短期技术性休整，但基本面依然强势。建议观望 48 小时，如果站稳 $63.5K 可以小仓位试多。如果跌破 $62.8K，算力逻辑和散户行为都失效，需要重新评估下跌风险。

My observation is that Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade is retaining its original storage fee plan despite a seven-week delay, suggesting that the development team prioritizes implementing consistent rules over making concessions for the compatibility of individual contracts. This assessment depends on the two media reports accurately reflecting the developers’ final decision at their meeting.

According to Cointelegraph, Glamsterdam’s Hoodi upgrade was postponed in October because changes to gas pricing could break some existing smart contracts. CoinDesk, meanwhile, reports that developers have agreed to retain the originally planned storage fees, bringing the seven-week delay to an end and setting a testing schedule for mid-December. The two reports corroborate one key point: the central dispute is not whether to upgrade, but who will bear the cost of the changes to fee rules that the upgrade brings.

Mechanically, changes to storage fees will alter the cost structure for deploying contracts and accessing on-chain storage. For contracts that are already deployed, logic that relies on old gas assumptions could lead to higher execution costs or even unexpected behavior. By choosing to retain the plan, developers are effectively shifting the compatibility burden to contract maintainers rather than making exceptions at the protocol level. My inference is that this trade-off will help prevent fragmented rules, but will raise the maintenance bar for some older contracts in the short term.

Conditions worth monitoring next include whether public reports of contract compatibility issues emerge after the Hoodi testnet goes live; whether developers publish migration guidance for affected contracts; and whether the December schedule stays on track. If the testnet reveals widespread contract failures, the decision to retain the original plan may be reconsidered. This article does not constitute investment advice.

我的观察是：以太坊Glamsterdam升级在延迟七周后仍保留原定存储收费方案，说明开发团队更看重规则统一推进，而非为个别合约兼容性让步。这个判断成立的前提是，两家媒体的报道准确反映了开发者会议的最终决定。

据Cointelegraph报道，Glamsterdam的Hoodi升级此前在10月被推迟，原因是gas定价调整可能破坏部分现有智能合约。CoinDesk则称，开发者已同意保留原计划的存储收费，结束了七周延迟，并敲定12月中旬的测试时间表。两条报道交叉印证了一个事实：争议核心不是要不要升级，而是升级带来的成本规则变化由谁承担。

从机制上看，存储收费调整会改变合约部署和调用链上存储的成本结构。对已部署合约而言，如果其逻辑依赖旧有gas假设，就可能出现执行成本上升甚至行为异常。开发者选择保留方案，等于把兼容性压力转移给合约维护者，而不是在协议层做例外处理。我的推断是，这种取舍有利于避免规则碎片化，但短期会抬高部分老合约的维护门槛。

接下来值得跟踪的验证条件包括：Hoodi测试网上线后是否出现合约兼容性问题的公开反馈；开发者是否披露针对受影响合约的迁移指引；以及12月时间表能否按计划执行。如果测试网暴露出大范围合约故障，保留原方案的决定可能面临重新评估。本文不构成投资建议。

ETH variable-size Blob draft emerges｜Potential boost to L2 efficiency for small-batch data submissions｜Waiting for confirmation near 1737

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I won’t treat a draft as an already-implemented scaling benefit. On November 26, a pull request for “Variable-Size Blobs,” numbered 8521, appeared in Ethereum’s EIPs repository. It is still marked Draft, has not been merged, and is nowhere near being live on mainnet. The draft depends on another post-quantum PeerDAS proposal. It would allow data Blobs to use power-of-two lengths ranging from 2 KB to 1 MB, while retaining 128 columns and planning to account for resources by byte. The document itself also says that fee transitions and activation requirements remain unresolved. These are all proposal details, not rules that have already taken effect onchain today.

Why is this worth watching? Fixed-size Blobs currently leave L2 publishers whose data falls short of a full Blob with two choices: pay for unused capacity or wait for more transactions to accumulate into a batch. If variable-length Blobs are ultimately accepted, they could reduce the cost and waiting time for small-batch submissions, affecting the actual fees Rollups charge users. But the proposal also involves proofs, verification, network propagation, and fee design, so it does not directly imply that ETH revenue or the amount burned will necessarily increase. To track development, watch subsequent discussions, client implementations, testnets, and official upgrade plans—not just the headline and a price rally.

Market reactions also need to be attributed carefully. At the time of writing, ETHUSDT on Binance was around $1,737, up about 2.7% over 24 hours, with a low of around $1,668 and a high of around $1,755. The price increase is a market fact, but it does not prove that the draft drove it; holiday-period liquidity and other macro expectations could also have affected the price action. ETH appearing among Binance Square’s Most Searched assets indicates interest, but search activity is not the same as net spot buying.

The key levels I’m watching are the intraday high near $1,755 and the round-number level at $1,700. If price holds above $1,755 on increased volume and then retests it without breaking below, short-term strength would be more credible. If it falls back below $1,700, today’s upward structure would be called into question, with $1,668 as a further risk reference. These price levels come from the current trading range; they are trading conditions, not “target prices” from the protocol draft. If a subsequent review rejects the proposal, or the market loses $1,700 and rebounds weakly, I will withdraw my bullish view.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t chase the price right now. I’d only consider a small spot long, with no more than 5% of total funds allocated to any single trade, and no leverage. I’d enter in stages only if price breaks above $1,755, then retests and holds that level without a clear drop in volume. My first target would be $1,785 and my second $1,810. I’d sell half at the first target and move the protective stop on the remainder up to around the entry price. I’d set the initial stop-loss below the retest low; if there is no clear retest low, I wouldn’t enter. If the daily close falls back below $1,700 or the draft receives a major negative revision, I’d close the entire position regardless of profit or loss. If none of these conditions are triggered, I’d stay out of the market—I would never present watching as though it were a completed trade.

ETH出现可变大小Blob草案｜利好L2小批量上链效率｜1737附近只等确认

我的态度是审慎偏多，但不会把一份草案当成已落地的扩容利好。以太坊EIPs仓库11月26日出现编号8521的“Variable-Size Blobs”草案拉取请求，目前仍标为Draft，尚未合并，更没有主网上线。草案依赖另一项后量子PeerDAS提案，允许数据Blob按2KB到1MB的二次幂长度选择，仍保持128列，并计划按字节核算资源。文件自己也写明费用过渡和激活要求尚未解决。这些都是提案内容，不是今天链上已经生效的规则。

为什么值得看？现在固定大小的Blob使数据量不足一整块的L2发布者面临两种选择：为闲置容量付费，或等待更多交易凑批次。可变长度如果最终被接受，可能降低小批量发布的成本和等待时间，影响Rollup给用户的实际费用。但它同时牵涉证明、验证、网络传播和费用设计，不能直接推导出ETH收入或销毁量必然增加。开发进度应看后续讨论、客户端实现、测试网和正式升级安排，而不是看标题就追涨。

市场反应也要分清归因。截稿时币安ETHUSDT约1737美元，24小时约涨2.7%，区间低点约1668、高点约1755。价格上涨是市场事实，不能证明由这份草案推动；假日时段流动性与其他宏观预期同样可能影响走势。币安广场Most Searched有ETH，说明关注度存在，但搜索热度不等于现货净买盘。

关键位我看1755附近的日内高点和1700整数位。若放量站稳1755并回踩不破，短线强势才更可信；若跌回1700下方，今天的上行结构就先打折，1668是进一步风险参考。这里的价格位来自即时交易区间，是交易条件，不是协议草案的“目标价”。若后续审查否决该方案，或市场失守1700且反弹乏力，我的偏多判断撤回。

如果是我自己交易：目前不追价，方向只考虑现货轻仓做多，单次计划最多占总资金5%，不使用杠杆。只有价格突破1755后回踩守住且成交量没有明显萎缩，才分批入场；第一目标看1785，第二目标看1810，到第一目标减掉一半，余仓把保护位上移至入场附近。初始止损设在回踩低点下方，若没有清晰回踩低点则不参与；若日线收回1700下方或草案出现重大负面修订，无论盈亏全部平仓。若始终不触发，就保持空仓，绝不把观察写成成交。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Through Risk, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound it a few times
to turn it into dozens of times your starting capital. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【What compounding positions involves】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you treat them as risk capital for new positions and keep trading,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is astounding; once it stops, your unrealized gains can
go from dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big drops.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

Ethereum’s Co-Founder Takes On Crypto’s Next Security Threat. Who Is Vitalik Buterin?

Vitalik Buterin’s November 26 essay argues that crypto security must extend to the physical chips inside devices, summed up as “Not your silicon, not your keys.”
He wants manufacturers to publish physical chip layouts (GDS files) so investigators can compare real hardware against the design.
Researcher Andrew Huang’s infrared inspection technique (IRIS) can examine chips without removing them, but it has resolution limits and is not a universal fix.
The essay is a proposal, not a claim that existing hardware wallets are compromised, and publishing it does not give Buterin power to change Ethereum unilaterally.
Arkham attributes about $390 million in assets to Buterin, mostly roughly 224,000 $ETH, though his true net worth is not publicly established.

Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know

Ethereum's core developers decided on Thursday to go ahead with a contested change to how the network charges for storing data, leaving the companies behind thousands of potentially affected programs racing to fix their code before a final public test on Dec. 15.

The change is part of Glamsterdam, the next major upgrade to Ethereum, the second-largest cryptocurrency network. It sharply raises the cost of creating new permanent data on the blockchain, which could cause some existing programs, known as smart contracts, to run out of fees partway through a transaction and fail.

The teams that build Ethereum's core software "reached a rough consensus to proceed with the current Glamsterdam spec as is, despite some concerns about potential breakage and the usability of the gas opcode," a summary of the meeting shows. The gas opcode is the command that programs use to check how much of fees they have left.

The upgrade's last public test is scheduled for Dec. 15 on Hoodi, a network that developers use as a dress rehearsal before changes go live on Ethereum itself. That is seven weeks later than originally planned.

As CoinDesk previously reported, an Oct. 26 test was called off after security firm ChainSecurity warned that the changes could alter how programs already running on the network behave.

The rule at the center of the fight, EIP-8037, is Ethereum's way of stopping its database from ballooning as Glamsterdam crams more activity into every block. It slaps a separate storage charge on anything that creates new permanent data.

Glamsterdam's storage charge gives contract teams until Dec. 15. (Shaurya Malwa/CoinDesk)
What potential problem exists

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：反弹动能与机构撤离的拉锯战

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二十七日，以太坊现货价格报一千七百四十二美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之三点二二。价格在过去五个小时内从一千七百零一美元的低点强势拉升至一千七百五十五美元的高位，最新一根小时K线小幅回落至一千七百三十四美元收盘。这波反弹的成交量在第一小时达到五千八百三十万美元，随后回落至一千五百万美元左右的常态水平，显示初始拉升有较强的买盘推动。

从K线形态观察，以太坊连续五根K线呈现阶梯式上涨，每根K线的高点和低点逐步抬升，形成了标准的上升通道。但最新一根K线出现了明显的上影线，从一千七百四十三美元的高点回落至一千七百三十四美元，表明一千七百五十五美元附近存在较强的卖压。整体来看，短期反弹结构完好，但上攻动能正在衰减。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现健康的多头排列。七周期均线报一千七百二十三点二四美元，二十五周期均线报一千七百零五点零四美元，九十九周期均线报一千六百九十七点零二美元。价格运行在所有均线上方，且短期均线向上发散，中期趋势偏多。指数移动平均线同样确认了这一格局，七周期EMA报一千七百二十五点五八美元，与价格紧密贴合。

RSI指标出现了值得关注的变化。六周期RSI从八十五点七八的高位回落至七十一点五零，虽然仍处于偏高区域，但已经脱离了极端超买状态，说明短期过热有所缓解。十二周期RSI报六十八点一八，二十四周期RSI报六十一点七九，中长期RSI仍处于温和偏多区间。

MACD指标维持多头格局。DIF线报十一点一五，信号线报七点六一，柱状图报三点五四。虽然柱状图较前值三点六四略有收窄，但整体仍保持扩张态势，多头动能尚未衰竭。布林带上轨报一千七百三十七点八二美元，价格已经突破上轨运行，存在回归中轨一千七百零七点四四美元的技术需求。

KDJ指标中K值七十五点三九，D值七十四点一四，J值七十七点八九，三线处于高位但已经出现拐头迹象。量化因子方面，十五个因子中十个发出做空信号，综合指标值为负零点九八，整体偏空，但做多因子的历史胜率高达百分之九十四点四四，说明多头信号一旦出现可靠性较高。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多空因素交织的复杂局面。利好方面，以色列Discount Bank推出了以太坊直接交易服务，标志着传统金融机构对ETH的认可度持续提升。技术层面，核心开发团队宣布Glamsterdam测试网将于十二月十五日上线，为下一次重大升级铺路。鲸鱼活动方面，出现了三万六千一百九十五枚ETH的THORChain大额交换以及一万一千枚ETH从交易所提出，显示大户正在积极积累。

$BFUSD: Would Indicator Agreement Be Independent Evidence?

Does $BFUSD resting inside its recorded range while volume exceeds baseline prove a confluence zone is active? The observation lists 18.83x baseline volume with hourly direction flat or unavailable. A common assumption suggests that when value metrics like RSI 42.7 align with trend lines such as the short-term EMA at 0.99956, a reliable decision point emerges. This view treats indicator agreement as standalone proof that price respects a specific level. However, this interpretation assumes that multiple smooth averages react independently to distinct market forces.

Consider a counterexample where the RSI remains elevated while price stagnates. In that scenario, the trend line might simply reflect past momentum rather than current support. If the RSI drifts lower without a corresponding drop in price, the supposed confluence fails to trigger a directional move. This divergence indicates the reading was circular: the indicators were correlated because they measured overlapping data points, not because they confirmed each other from separate angles.

 A clear break below the local support at 0.9995 without a volume spike would challenge the value-based interpretation. Conversely, if price holds above the short-term EMA despite fading volume, the trend component may be weakening. To reassess, track whether the next hourly candle closes outside the prior range bounds. If it does, the confluence holds no predictive power. If it stays contained, the current static state persists, but causality remains unproven. This framework separates observation from inference, ensuring the analysis stays within the limits of the supplied data.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

Watchlist contrast: $ETH has hourly direction up and volume not above its baseline; $HAEDAL has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.
