My assessment is that the Cyber cross-chain bridge coming back online only means that testable routes have reopened; it does not mean the risks from the November 21 security incident have been eliminated. This assessment rests on treating “resumption of operations” and “completion of risk mitigation” as separate matters.

According to a November 27 report by PANews, Cyber said it had restored 14 routes across Ethereum, Optimism, BNB Chain, Base, and Solana, each of which passed end-to-end testing on mainnet. Under the mechanism, all cross-chain transfers require signatures from four independent validators: LayerZero Labs and Canary are mandatory, while two others are selected from Google Cloud, Twinstake, and Horizen. Bridge permissions are controlled by a 3/5 multisig. In my view, this design splits what might previously have been concentrated trust across two hurdles: signatures and multisig approval. However, the available information does not disclose which validator combinations are possible under the “choose two of four” arrangement, or who makes up the 3/5 multisig, so it is not possible to assess the actual degree of decentralization on this basis.

The boundaries of the phased restoration merit closer attention: routes to and from Cyber L2 remain disabled, indicating that the mainnet routes passing testing does not cover all fund flows. It follows that cross-chain functionality remains incomplete until the L2 routes are restored. Users and fund providers therefore need to assess each route individually, rather than treating “the bridge is back” as a blanket conclusion.

The conditions that would change this assessment are clear: if subsequent disclosures show that the L2 routes have been restored and that the multisig participants and validator rotation rules are transparent, the risk assessment could be lowered accordingly. If details of the incident’s losses, root cause, and post-incident report remain undisclosed, then the return to service should be viewed only as an improvement in operational status, not as a security conclusion. Three indicators are worth watching next: the timeline for restoring the remaining routes, the composition of the 3/5 multisig signers, and whether a post-incident review is published. This article does not constitute investment advice.

据PANews 11月27日报道，Cyber称已恢复以太坊、Optimism、BNB Chain、Base和Solana上的14条路由，每条均在主网通过端到端测试。机制上，所有跨链转账需四个独立验证者签名，LayerZero Labs和Canary为必选，另在Google Cloud、Twinstake与Horizen中任选两个；桥权限由3/5多签控制。我的观察是，这套设计把原先可能集中的信任拆成签名与多签两道门槛，但本次素材未披露“四选二”的可选验证者组合、以及3/5多签由谁构成，无法据此判断实际去中心化程度。

更值得跟踪的是分阶段恢复的边界：往返Cyber L2的路由仍处禁用状态，说明主网路由通过测试并不覆盖全部资金路径。据此推断，在L2路由恢复前，跨链能力仍是不完整的，用户和资金方需要按路由分别评估，而不能把“桥已恢复”当成统一结论。

判断失效的条件也很清楚：若后续公开信息显示L2路由恢复且多签主体、验证者轮换规则透明，风险判断可相应下调；若后续迟迟未披露事件损失、根因和事后报告，则恢复上线只能视为运行状态改善，不能视为安全结论。接下来值得看三个指标：剩余路由的恢复时间、3/5多签的签名方构成、是否发布事后复盘。本文不构成投资建议。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why Being Able to Take Losses Keeps You in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
An account that’s down just 20% can recover with a few winning trades. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
after three consecutive losses, you’re left with just 34% and need to nearly double your money to break even—mathematically, you’re all but finished.

【How to apply it】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

ETH Breaks Past 1740 | Separate Outflows from Older Funds from New Protocol Proposals | Wait for a Retest Before Re-entering

My stance is to wait for now, rather than interpreting ETH’s rise today as a direct sign of institutional money returning. Binance Square is discussing #CanMarketsReboundAfterThanksgiving?, and ETH also appears on the six-hour Most Searched list. Meanwhile, a PR dated November 26 appeared in Ethereum’s official consensus-specifications repository: it proposes adding a protocol version entry for the BeaconBlocksByHead response in the future Heze release, bringing it into line with the other two entries for requesting blocks by range and by root. The project page shows that its status is still Open, with no review conclusion and no deployment. This indicates that developers are checking future protocol compatibility details; it does not mean Heze is already on mainnet, ETH throughput has increased, or this minor change drove today’s price. Technical progress is valuable, but price reactions require separate evidence.

The institutional flow data we can currently verify remain cautious. Farside’s table for U.S. spot ETH funds shows net outflows of about $68.5 million on November 25, all from ETHA; the other columns show zero. These “zeros” are the records for the respective products in that day’s summary table; they do not mean that nobody in the entire market bought ETH. U.S. markets were closed for Thanksgiving on November 26, so the missing trading day should not be treated as a new zero-flow reading. The New York Stock Exchange calendar shows an early close at 13:00 Eastern Time on November 27, so we still need to wait for today’s fund subscription and redemption data after the market opens and closes. If ETH spot rises first today while funds continue to see outflows, that would indicate a short-term divergence between crypto spot markets and traditional fund channels. If net inflows resume, that would provide more solid cross-validation for the rebound. Neither scenario can be stated as fact yet.

ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,742 when checked, with a 24-hour open of about $1,696, a low of $1,667.94, a high of $1,755.22, and a gain of about 2.7%. The market has rebounded from its low and moved above 1740, but it remains some distance below the intraday high; a single touch does not constitute a valid breakout. I view the 1740–1755 range as a supply zone that needs to be retested, and 1685 and 1667.94 as levels to watch for support. If the four-hour price falls back below 1710, especially if fund outflows continue after the data are released, that would invalidate the short-term view that price has “held firm.” Conversely, only if spot price holds on a retest and both trading activity and fund data improve would it be worth moving from observation to action.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only an unleveraged spot long. I would open a position using no more than 0.25% of total capital only if all three conditions are met: a four-hour close holds above 1755; a subsequent retest of 1740–1755 is met with buying; and the day’s fund flows show no further significant deterioration. Otherwise, I would remain flat. The first target is 1785, where I would take half off; the next is 1820, where I would close the rest. I would exit at a loss if the four-hour candle closes below 1710. If price breaks below 1667.94 before entry, I would cancel the plan outright. If it proves to be a false breakout accompanied by widening spreads, I would exit according to the rules rather than use a future upgrade proposal or outdated fund data to justify a losing position. If the conditions are not triggered, no trade has been made; a plan cannot be described as money already earned.

ETH冲过1740｜基金旧流出与协议新提案要分开看｜回踩确认再入场

我的态度是先等，不把ETH今天的上涨直接解释为机构回流。币安广场正在讨论#CanMarketsReboundAfterThanksgiving?，ETH也出现在Most Searched六小时名单。与此同时，以太坊官方共识规范仓库11月26日出现PR #5867：提案为未来Heze版本的BeaconBlocksByHead响应补充协议版本表项，使其与另两种按区间、按根请求区块的表项一致。项目页面显示状态仍为Open、没有审查结论，也未部署。它说明开发者正在检查未来协议的兼容细节，不能写成Heze已经上主网、ETH吞吐量已经提高，更不能说这项小改动推动了今天的价格。技术进度有价值，但价格反应必须另找证据。

目前能核对的机构资金数据仍偏谨慎。Farside的美国现货ETH基金表中，11月25日净流出约6850万美元，且这一列全部来自ETHA；其他列显示为零。这个“零”是该汇总表当日对应产品的记录，不等于全市场没有任何人买入ETH。11月26日美国感恩节休市，不能把缺失的交易日当成新的零流量。纽约证券交易所日历显示11月27日美东13:00提前收市，所以今天基金净申赎仍需等开市和收盘后的资料。若今天ETH现货先涨，随后基金仍持续流出，说明加密现货与传统基金渠道短期信号分歧；若资金恢复净流入，才是对反弹更扎实的交叉验证。两种情形现在都不能预写成事实。

币安ETH/USDT本次查看约1742美元，24小时开盘约1696、低点1667.94、高点1755.22，涨幅约2.7%。市场已经从低位反弹并越过1740，但当前离日内高点仍有距离，单次触及不是有效突破。我把1740至1755看作需要重新检验的供给区，1685和1667.94看作防守观察位。若四小时重新跌回1710以下，尤其基金数据公布后仍持续流出，就推翻“已站稳”的短线判断。反过来，现货价格回踩不破、成交和基金数据共同改善，才值得从观察转为行动。

translatedData.content:
Tudor Investment Nearly Doubles IBIT Holdings to 1.36 Million Shares in One Quarter

A quarterly 13F filing submitted to U.S. regulators on November 16 showed that Tudor Investment, founded by Paul Tudor Jones, increased its holdings of BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) from 688,529 shares in the previous quarter to about 1.36 million, a 98% increase. As of September 30, the position was worth about $64.6 million, up approximately 182% in dollar terms, with roughly 42 percentage points of that increase attributable to IBIT’s price appreciation. The position remains below the peak of more than 8 million shares at the end of 2024.

The same batch of filings paints a broader picture of institutional activity: Wells Fargo became IBIT’s largest institutional holder, increasing its position from about 24.4 million shares to 49.58 million, a rise of approximately 103%, valued at about $2.347 billion. Brevan Howard increased its IBIT holdings by about 211% to roughly 22.41 million shares, valued at $1.061 billion. Goldman Sachs’s combined Bitcoin ETF holdings rose in value from about $580 million to $1.283 billion. Market maker Jane Street Group increased its exposure from about $200 million to $622 million. In the Middle East, Mubadala held about 14.72 million IBIT shares and the Abu Dhabi Investment Council held about 8.22 million, both unchanged from the previous quarter. Third-party data show that Wall Street institutions collectively added about $4.2 billion to their Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter.

Three points are worth bearing in mind when interpreting these figures. First, 13F filings provide a static snapshot at quarter-end and cannot confirm whether institutions continued buying during the price pullback from October to November. Second, the 98% increase is off a low base and remains far below Tudor’s historical peak; the impression created by “doubling” should be assessed separately from the actual exposure. Third, figures disclosed by banks and market makers often include assets managed on behalf of clients and should not be equated directly with proprietary investment views. During the same period, Bitcoin steadied near $64,600 in mid-November after ending a week-long drop of more than 15%, while spot ETFs recorded net outflows of about $1.9 billion over seven consecutive trading days.

In terms of market impact, the significance of institutional buying is that regulated channels are absorbing capital. IBIT is the largest spot Bitcoin ETF. As of November 17, it had cumulative net inflows of about $64.27 billion and net assets of approximately $53.99 billion, demonstrating continued demand even amid a period of outflows. Another variable is index rebalancing: MSCI is set to remove Bitcoin treasury companies such as Strategy from its benchmark indexes on November 30, prompting passive funds to adjust their holdings. Strategy disclosed that its latest average purchase price was $68,887, with total holdings of 850,849 coins. The relative strength of institutional buying in ETFs versus passive rebalancing in equities will affect Bitcoin’s medium-term ownership structure.

Overall, the evidence is insufficient to interpret Tudor’s increased holdings as a sign that institutions are collectively bullish and to infer the market’s near-term direction. A more cautious reading is that traditional financial capital is incorporating Bitcoin into the range of assets available for long-term allocation and gradually building positions through regulated channels. 都铎投资IBIT持仓单季增近一倍至136万份

11月16日提交给美国监管机构的13F季度文件显示，由保罗·都铎·琼斯创立的都铎投资，将贝莱德现货比特币ETF（IBIT）持仓从上一季度688,529份增至约136万份，份额增幅98%；按9月30日计价值约6,460万美元，美元口径增长约182%，其中约42个百分点来自IBIT价格上涨。该规模仍低于2024年末峰值时逾800万份的水平。

同一批申报勾勒出更广的机构图景：富国银行成为IBIT最大机构持有者，持仓由约2,440万股增至4,958万股，增幅约103%，估值约23.47亿美元；布雷万·霍华德将IBIT持仓提升约211%至约2,241万股，估值约10.61亿美元；高盛的比特币ETF合计估值由约5.8亿美元升至约12.83亿美元；做市商海纳国际集团敞口由约2亿美元升至约6.22亿美元。中东的穆巴达拉持有约1,472万股IBIT，阿布扎比投资委员会持有约822万股，两者份额与上季持平。第三方统计显示，华尔街三季度合计增持比特币ETF约42亿美元。

解读这批数据有三点值得留意。其一，13F反映的是季度末静态快照，无法证实机构在10月至11月价格回落期间是否继续买入。其二，98%增幅建立在低基数上，且远低于其历史峰值，“翻倍”观感与实际敞口应分开评估。其三，银行与做市商披露的金额常包含代客管理资产，不宜直接等同于自营观点。同期比特币在11月中旬结束单周逾15%的下跌后于64,600美元附近整理，现货ETF曾连续七个交易日净流出约19亿美元。

传导路径上，机构增持的意义在于合规渠道的资金承接。IBIT是体量最大的现货比特币ETF，截至11月17日累计净流入约642.7亿美元、净资产约539.9亿美元，在净流出周期中仍显现承接力。另一变量是指数调整：MSCI定于11月30日将Strategy等比特币财库公司剔除出基准指数，被动资金随之调仓；Strategy披露的最新购币均价为68,887美元、总持仓850,849枚。ETF端机构增持与股票端被动调仓的相对强弱，将影响比特币中期筹码结构。

综合看，把都铎的增持读成机构集体看涨并推导短期方向，证据并不充分；更稳妥的读法是，传统金融资本正把比特币纳入长期可配置资产类别，通过合规渠道逐步固化持仓。短线资金流出与长线机构资金沉淀并行，市场定价权缓慢转移，才是这批文件更值得记录的结构性变化。以上为基于公开披露的事实梳理，不构成投资建议。

ETH is currently at $1,657.21, down 1.6% over the past 24 hours and up 2.3% over the past 7 days. The truly interesting part isn’t the price, but that the Fear & Greed Index is only 12, showing extreme market fear, while trading volume has surged abnormally. But whether ETH can be revalued from here doesn’t hinge on whether “the next upgrade will bring a new narrative”; it hinges on whether the protocol upgrades can run reliably.

Ethereum’s roadmap is moving ahead with upgrades such as Glamsterdam and Hegotá. On December 15, the delayed Glamsterdam testnet upgrade will proceed as planned. Hoodi was previously put on hold over security concerns, with the controversy centering on the possibility that changes to gas pricing could break existing smart contracts. What’s that like? It’s not adding a luxury renovation to an old house; it’s modifying the gas pipes. In theory, it’s more efficient and can cut costs—but if even one old pipe isn’t connected properly, businesses throughout the entire building are affected.

In practice, who will be affected? Users care about transaction costs and reliability; DApp teams care about compatibility; and node operators, wallet providers, and infrastructure services will have to bear the costs of adaptation and testing. Does the business case hold up? First, the upgrade must not disrupt existing operations. Second, can the efficiency gains translate into more real users and lower costs? Third, will developers want to stay in the ecosystem and continue building?

So this time, I’d rather keep an eye on testnet performance, actual usage after the upgrade, and feedback from the ecosystem than buy into the concept first. Remember: ETH’s value isn’t in “how long the upgrade list is,” but in whether each upgrade makes the system more reliable, cheaper, and better able to support real-world business.

落到实处，谁会被影响？用户要看交易成本和稳定性；DApp团队要看兼容性；节点、钱包、基础设施服务商则要承担适配和测试成本。商业逻辑通不通？第一，先不能把现有业务跑坏；第二，升级后的效率提升，能否转化成更多真实用户和更低成本；第三，开发者是否愿意留在生态里持续建设。

以太坊市场深度分析：技术破位与升级预期的博弈

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间十一月二十七日晚间，以太坊现货价格报一千六百五十七点五五美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点八。盘中价格从一千六百七十一美元一线持续下行，最低触及一千六百五十三点九六美元，随后小幅反弹至一千六百六十美元上方震荡。从小时级别K线来看，最近五个交易时段呈现明显的下跌趋势，其中第三个时段出现放量下跌，成交量达到三千零八十一万美元，是前一个时段的四倍以上，显示抛压集中释放。

从均线系统观察，以太坊当前价格已经跌破所有短期和中期均线。七日均线报一千六百六十六点零一美元，二十五日均线报一千七百点三八美元，九十九日均线报一千六百八十八点五零美元。三条均线全部位于价格上方，形成典型的空头排列。特别值得注意的是，价格与二十五日均线之间的差距较大，显示中短期下跌趋势较为明显。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，当前MACD线报负十二点八三，信号线报负七点五五，柱状图报负五点二九。MACD线持续位于零轴下方且加速下行，但柱状图从负五点九八收窄至负五点二九，显示下跌动能虽然仍在主导，但边际力度有所减弱。这种柱状图收窄的现象通常先于价格反弹出现，需要密切关注后续是否能形成底背离。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI报二十五点九五，十二周期RSI报三十一点八一，二十四周期RSI报三十九点七零。短期RSI已经跌破三十，进入超卖区域。这是一个重要的技术信号，表明短期内卖压过度释放，存在技术性反弹的需求。从历史走势来看，RSI跌破二十五后往往会在短期内出现反弹，但反弹幅度取决于整体市场情绪。

布林带指标方面，上轨报一千七百六十四点一零美元，中轨报一千六百九十八点二八美元，下轨报一千六百三十二点四六美元。当前价格位于中轨下方，距离下轨仅约二十五美元。布林带开口较大，显示波动率处于高位。价格在下轨附近获得支撑，可能形成短期反弹机会，但要突破中轨需要较强的买盘推动。

KDJ指标中，K线报三十六点四零，D线报三十四点一零，J线报四十一点零零。K线从之前的三十点七七快速上穿D线，形成金叉信号。这是一个积极的短期信号，结合RSI的超卖状态，可能预示短期反弹即将展开。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重压力。资金面方面，以太坊ETF在十一月份累计流出超过十二亿美元，连续八个交易日出现净流出，累计流出达五点二三亿美元。机构资金的持续撤离对现货市场形成了显著压制。

技术升级方面，Glamsterdam升级的测试网计划于十二月十五日启动，这是以太坊网络的重要技术迭代。然而，开发团队在跨链桥和钱包集成中发现了约两百个软件缺陷，这给升级的顺利推进带来了不确定性。市场对升级既抱有期待又存在担忧，这种矛盾心理反映在价格的震荡走势中。

鲸鱼动向方面，大型地址在近期增持了约三万八千二百二十九枚以太坊并参与质押，显示长期持有者对当前价位的认可。但另一方面，约一万一千九百八十九枚与黑客攻击相关的以太坊被转移至非托管钱包，存在潜在的抛售风险。

宏观环境方面，加密货币市场与美股出现脱钩现象。纳斯达克期货上涨百分之二点五，标普五百期货突破七千三百点，但比特币和以太坊并未跟随上涨，反而继续下行。这种脱钩表明加密市场正在消化自身的利空因素，包括ETF流出和监管不确定性。

综合来看，以太坊当前处于技术面超卖但基本面承压的阶段。短期存在技术性反弹的可能，但中期走势仍取决于ETF资金流向和Glamsterdam升级的进展。投资者需要关注一千六百三十美元的关键支撑位，以及能否有效突破一千七百元美元的心理关口。

热门代币追踪

PORTAL当前价格零点零三七七四美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二百零三点三八，成交量六千一百七十九万美元。该代币因转向AI游戏创作概念而暴涨，但RSI已超过九十，存在严重超买风险。

ACE当前价格零点一零六八美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之四十五点九零，成交量一百八十六万美元。价格接近日内高点零点一零七美元，显示买盘强劲。

HAEDAL当前价格零点零二三五零美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十九点七六，成交量两千一百九十五万美元。从低点零点零一八零三美元反弹，显示资金关注度提升。

ETH Account Migration Proposal Reveals Compatibility Risks | Researcher Offers Two Corrective Rules | I’m Not Chasing the Rebound for Now

My stance is defensive. On November 27, an empirical report on EIP-8298 appeared on the Ethereum Research Forum. The author tested the proposed SETCODEFROM instruction using bytecode from contracts that have actually been deployed on mainnet. The instruction aims to let accounts reuse existing contract code and provide a migration path for accounts to adopt post-quantum authorization in the future. The report identifies two compatibility risks in the old draft: first, the code observed externally during execution may differ from the code actually running at that moment; second, if borrowed code can rewrite an account’s code, the control logic of some smart-contract wallets could be replaced. The author constructed two test scenarios using bytecode from existing contracts and proposed two constraints: defer the code switch until the outermost execution frame has completed, and allow only an account’s own code to initiate a replacement.

The factual boundaries need to be clear: the official EIP page still lists 8298 as Draft, and the research forum post explicitly says SETCODEFROM has not yet been deployed. The experiment does not mean that a mainnet wallet was attacked, nor that the corrective rules have already been incorporated into the final specification. I checked the EIP text: the current draft still describes updating the code hash immediately after the instruction executes, while the current frame continues running the original code. That is precisely the compatibility issue the researcher wants to discuss. What is really worth watching is whether revisions to the proposal, client implementations, and devnet testing can jointly demonstrate both security and migration usability—not dressing up a research finding as a security incident that has already happened to ETH.

Its impact on the crypto market is a mismatch between long-term trust and short-term pricing. If the account migration mechanism is robust enough in the future, it could reduce the cost of switching accounts along the post-quantum roadmap. If compatibility issues are underestimated, wallet and application integration will take longer. This does not automatically increase ETH burns or ETF inflows today. Farside data shows that U.S. spot ETH funds saw net outflows totaling $68.5 million on November 25; the individual products’ figures for November 27 are still dashes, and an automatically calculated total of zero should not be treated as a confirmed zero flow. Kraken ETH/USD is around $1,656 in this period, with a rolling 24-hour open of $1,687.68, low of $1,632.16, and high of $1,752.33. The research post’s publication date overlaps with this market window, but the decline cannot be directly attributed to it.

I regard $1,632 as the most recent verifiable risk low, around $1,688 as the rolling opening level, and $1,705 as the threshold for short-term bulls to prove buyers are stepping in again. If I were trading myself, I would stay out for now and consider only an unleveraged spot long. I would enter with at most 0.12% of total capital only if a four-hour candle closes back above $1,705, the price retests and holds $1,695–$1,705, and there is no new client security announcement. ETH账户迁移提案发现兼容风险｜研究者给出两条修正规则｜我暂不追反弹

我的态度偏防守。11月27日以太坊研究论坛出现一份针对EIP-8298的实测报告，作者用主网上真实部署过的合约字节码，测试拟议的SETCODEFROM指令。该指令的目标，是让账户复用已经存在的合约代码，并为账户以后改用抗量子授权提供一条迁移路径。报告指出旧草案有两类兼容风险：一是执行过程中外部观察到的代码与当前实际运行代码可能不一致；二是借来的代码若能替账户改写代码，某些代理钱包的控制逻辑可能被替换。作者用现有合约字节码构造了两个实验情形，并提出延迟到最外层执行帧完成后再切换代码、以及只允许账户自己的代码发起替换两条约束。

事实边界要说清：EIP官网仍将8298标为Draft，研究论坛帖明确说SETCODEFROM尚未上线，实验不等于主网钱包遭攻击，也不等于修正规则已经进入最终规范。我核对了EIP正文，现有草案仍描述在指令执行后立即更新代码哈希、当前帧继续运行原代码；这正是研究者要讨论的兼容点。真正值得盯的是提案修订、客户端实现与开发网测试能否同时证明安全和迁移可用，而不是把一个研究发现包装成ETH已经发生安全事故。

它对加密市场的影响是长期信任与短期定价的错位。若未来账户迁移机制足够稳健，可减轻抗量子路线的账户切换成本；若兼容性问题被低估，钱包和应用接入将更慢。今天并没有因此自动增加ETH销毁或ETF申购。Farside数据显示11月25日美国ETH现货基金合计净流出6850万美元，11月27日各产品分项仍为横线，自动合计零不能视为已确认零流。Kraken ETH/USD本轮约1656美元，滚动24小时开1687.68、低1632.16、高1752.33；研究帖发布日期与该行情窗口重叠，但不能把跌幅直接归因于它。

translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your reasoning), what went wrong or right (execution),
and what you’ll change next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover: your losses
Your trade log is full of the same types of mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing immediately after a stop-loss,
and never being able to hold on to winning trades.

Market conditions change, but your behavior patterns won’t change automatically unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every bit of wisdom, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

First, write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Second, never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Third, never add to a losing position or average down.
Fourth, after three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Fifth, withdraw some of your profits. Take the money out, and leave your emotions behind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

AI may take down RSA encryption before quantum computers even arrive: should the crypto world be worried?

FT reports that AI could threaten RSA encryption before quantum computing does, creating short-term negative sentiment.

According to a report by Crypto Briefing citing the FT, advances in AI’s ability to solve complex mathematical problems could threaten mainstream encryption algorithms like RSA before quantum computers become viable. RSA is a foundation of internet security: banks, payment systems, and even the signature systems used by many cryptocurrencies rely on similar mathematical problems (integer factorization and discrete logarithms) to ensure security.

Put simply, people used to worry that “quantum supremacy” would arrive one day and render cryptography obsolete across the board. Now the FT’s point is: don’t wait for quantum computers—the pace at which AI’s problem-solving abilities are advancing could be faster, so the timeline may need to move up.

Of course, the report itself also says that “there is a great deal of uncertainty at present”—no specific model has been shown to crack any particular key. This is more a discussion of future risks. This kind of “shadow bearish catalyst” is the hardest to guard against because it can’t be disproven.

Market impact
- Short term: A classic narrative-driven bearish catalyst. BTC is now $59,813.45, down 1.74% over 24 hours, and ETH is at $1,664.16, down 2.49%. The market is already weak, and reports that the “foundations of crypto technology could be shaken” will amplify fear. Investors may temporarily sit on the sidelines, while defensive assets strengthen. $\text{SOL } $71.99 is still managing to turn green, suggesting that altcoins’ own narratives are temporarily outweighing macro anxiety.
- Medium term: This could instead become an industry catalyst. Historically, every discussion about “cryptography being cracked” has ultimately accelerated the transition to post-quantum cryptography (PQC). If the RSA risk is confirmed, public blockchains that are first to adopt post-quantum signatures could command a valuation premium. It’s a narrative that could reshuffle the deck.

In a nutshell: this doesn’t mean cryptography has been cracked today. It means the “timeline for cracking it” has moved from science fiction to the news pages.

My take
Bearish in the short term; wait and see in the medium term. The market is in a downtrend, and reports about technological fears that can’t be immediately disproven are the perfect fuel for bears. BTC is likely to face pressure in the short term. But honestly, if AI really does crack RSA, the banking system would collapse before Bitcoin. Crypto assets might even be repriced thanks to their “decentralized and migratable” nature. I’m about 60% confident in this view; I’ll leave the remaining 40% to market sentiment. I’m only taking a small position to test the waters, so go easy on me if I’m wrong.

FT报道称AI可能先于量子计算威胁RSA加密，短期是情绪利空。

据Crypto Briefing转引FT的报道，AI在解决复杂数学问题上的进展，可能在量子计算机成熟之前，就对RSA这类主流加密算法构成威胁。RSA是互联网安全的底层地基，银行、支付、包括不少加密货币的签名体系都依赖类似的数学难题（大数分解、离散对数）来保证安全。

说白了，以前大家担心的是“量子霸权”哪天来了密码学集体作废，现在FT的意思是：别等量子计算机了，AI的解题能力进化速度可能更快，时间表要提前。

当然，报道自己也说了“目前不确定性很大”——没有具体哪个模型破解了哪条密钥，更多是前瞻性风险讨论。这种“影子利空”最难防，因为没法证伪。

对市场的影响
- 短期：典型的叙事层面利空。BTC现在 $59,813.45，24小时跌1.74%，ETH $1,664.16跌2.49%，市场本来就弱，这种“加密技术根基可能被动摇”的报道会放大恐慌情绪。资金会暂时偏向观望，防御盘走强。 $\text{SOL } $71.99还能翻红，说明山寨自己的故事暂时压过了宏观焦虑。
- 中期：反而可能是行业催化剂。历史上每次“加密将被破解”的讨论，最终都推动了抗量子密码（PQC）的迁移加速。如果RSA风险真被坐实，率先完成抗量子签名的公链会拿到估值溢价，这是个重新洗牌的叙事。

一句话翻译：这不是说密码今天就被破了，而是说“破解时间表”这个话题，从科幻提前到了新闻版面。

我的判断
看空短线，观望中线。市场处于下跌趋势中，这种无法立即证伪的技术恐慌报道，就是空头最好的燃料，BTC短期内承压概率大。但说句实话，RSA真被AI破解的话，最先崩的是银行系统而不是比特币，加密资产反而可能因为“去中心化+可迁移”被重新定价。这判断我大概六成把握，剩下四成交给市场情绪。我自己也只拿小仓位试错，说错轻喷。

title: Steps should I take if my Monero hardware wallet balance isn't syncing?
subTitle:
#monerofalls13%ondelistings 
Monero uses privacy features like stealth addresses and ring signatures, meaning your wallet must actively scan the entire blockchain to detect outputs sent to your device. When a hardware wallet (Ledger or Trezor) shows a zero or outdated balance, it almost always stems from a node connection stall, an incorrect wallet restore height, or a software connection timeout.
Step 1: Check Connection Status & Switch to a Remote Node
Your wallet software (Monero GUI, Feather, or Cake Wallet) needs a two-way connection to the Monero network:
Check Node Status: Look at the status bar at the bottom left. If it reads "Disconnected" or gets stuck on "Connecting...", your software is failing to query the blockchain.Switch Remote Node: Go to Settings $\rightarrow$ Node. Change from your local node to a reliable, high-uptime remote node (e.g., node.community.as, node.moneroworld.com, or node.xmr.to on port 18081).Disable Proxy / VPN Interference: If you run a strict VPN, firewall, or SOCKS5 proxy, temporarily disable it or allow full outbound access for your wallet software, as blocked ports break node syncing.
Step 2: Fix the Wallet Restore Height (Most Common Issue)
When connecting a hardware wallet, the software assigns a restore height (the block number from which it scans). If this block height is set after the block in which your transaction occurred, the wallet will completely skip your transaction and display a 0 balance.
Go to Settings $\rightarrow$ Info in your desktop wallet software (Monero GUI / Feather).Locate Wallet restore height and click (Change).Enter a block height or date prior to your wallet's creation or first deposit:Example: If you created the wallet in January 2024, set the date to 2024-01-01 or set the block height to a lower number like 3000000.Confirm clearing the local wallet cache. The wallet will rescan the blockchain from that earlier block onward, revealing your balance once synced.
Step 3: Check Hardware Wallet Device Approvals
Monero hardware wallets require physical confirmation to export view keys:
Ledger Users: Open the Monero app on the physical Ledger device before launching your desktop wallet app. When prompted on the Ledger screen, click both buttons to confirm "Export View Key".Trezor Users: Open your wallet interface (Monero GUI or Trezor Suite) and confirm the on-screen prompt on your Trezor device permitting watch-only key exports.USB Cable / Port: Ensure you are using a data-capable USB cable plugged directly into your computer (avoid unpowered USB hubs, which drop hardware connections mid-scan).
Step 4: Rebuild the Local Wallet Cache
If the wallet gets stuck at a specific block number during scan:
Close your Monero GUI / Feather client completely.Navigate to your wallet files directory on your computer (where your .keys file is located).Delete only the file without an extension (the cache file carrying your wallet's name). Do not delete the .keys file or your seed!Reopen your wallet app and re-connect your hardware wallet. The app will rebuild a clean cache file from scratch.

Haveno is a decentralized, peer-to-peer (P2P) desktop network designed for trading Monero (XMR) directly for fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD) or other cryptocurrencies without accounts, KYC verification, or central exchange custody.
It is based on the architectural foundation of Bisq, but built specifically around Monero’s native multi-signature technology and routed entirely through Tor for privacy.
Step-by-Step Overview of a Haveno Trade
Trading on Haveno relies on 2-of-3 multisig escrow, where three keys are distributed among the Buyer (Taker/Maker), Seller, and an automated Dispute Arbitrator.

Step 1: Initial Setup & Payment Method
Download & Launch: Run the Haveno desktop client (or a network instance like RetoSwap). The client connects via Tor and creates a local Monero wallet.Add Payment Method: Set up your preferred off-chain fiat payment method inside your account settings (e.g., SEPA, Bank Transfer, Zelle, Revolut, Instant Bank, or Cash by Mail).Fund Security Deposit: Both parties need a small amount of XMR in their local Haveno wallet to cover the protocol security deposit (typically 15%–50% of the trade value). This deposit acts as collateral to prevent non-payment or griefing.
Step 2: Creating or Taking an Offer
Maker: Creates an offer on the decentralized order book specifying the trade direction (Buy or Sell XMR), trade amount, fiat currency, and acceptable payment methods.Taker: Browses the order book filter, selects a matching offer, and clicks Take Offer.
Step 3: Funding the 2-of-3 Multisig Escrow
Once an offer is accepted, the trade window opens:
Haveno generates a temporary 2-of-3 Monero multisig address. The 3 private key shares belong to:Key 1: BuyerKey 2: SellerKey 3: Dispute ArbitratorThe Seller deposits the XMR being sold + their security deposit into the multisig escrow.The Buyer deposits their security deposit into the multisig escrow.The client waits for on-chain block confirmations to lock the escrow.
Step 4: External Fiat Payment
Haveno displays the Seller's payment details (e.g., bank account number or payment tag) to the Buyer.The Buyer opens their personal banking application outside of Haveno and transfers the exact fiat amount directly to the Seller.Note: Haveno does not touch or process fiat money directly; it only coordinates the cryptographic escrow.After completing the payment, the Buyer clicks Payment Sent inside the Haveno application.
Step 5: Trade Settlement & Deposit Return
The Seller checks their bank account or payment app to verify that the fiat funds have cleared.Once verified, the Seller clicks Payment Received in Haveno.Clicking this generates the Seller's signature. Combined with the Buyer's signature, the 2-of-3 threshold is met without needing the Arbitrator:The Buyer receives the purchased XMR + their returned security deposit.The Seller gets their security deposit refunded back to their wallet.
Dispute Resolution (In Case of Disagreements)
If a buyer claims they paid but the seller never received the money (or the seller stops responding):
Either trader can click Open Dispute within the trade panel.An Arbitrator joins an encrypted chat built into the Haveno client.Both parties submit proof (e.g., PGP-signed bank statements, receipt uploads).The Arbitrator uses their 3rd Key along with the honest trader’s key (forming 2-of-3 signatures) to release the escrowed Monero to the rightful own

title: How do Monero reserve proofs work in eigenwallet to verify maker liquidity before trading?
subTitle:
#monerofalls13%ondelistings 
Monero reserve proofs in eigenwallet allow market makers to cryptographically prove they hold enough Monero (XMR) to execute a swap before the taker commits any Bitcoin (BTC) on-chain.
Because Monero uses stealth addresses and ring signatures to hide account balances, reserve proofs bypass this default opacity using cryptographic signatures without compromising ongoing privacy.
How Reserve Proofs Function Cryptographically
When a maker publishes an exchange quote in the order book, they can attach a cryptographic Reserve Proof:

Key Ownership Verification: The maker generates a signature using their Monero private spend key associated with real, unspent outputs (UTXOs) on the Monero blockchain.Pedersen Commitment Validation: The proof proves that the sum of the maker's outputs meets or exceeds the required threshold (e.g., proving control over $\ge 50\text{ XMR}$) without revealing the maker's full wallet balance or revealing their real public address.Key Image Binding: The proof binds the claimed outputs to their corresponding Monero key images. This prevents double-claiming (a maker cannot use the exact same Monero outputs to fake reserve proofs across multiple concurrent orders).
Why Reserve Proofs are Critical for Takers
In a BTC-to-XMR atomic swap, the Taker locks Bitcoin first into a 2-of-2 multisig script.
Without reserve proofs, a bad-faith or illiquid maker could advertise high liquidity, causing takers to lock BTC into time-locked contracts. If the maker turns out to have zero XMR available:
The swap stalls.The taker's BTC remains locked in the script until the cancellation/refund timelock expires (taking 5 to 24+ hours).The taker loses time, pays Bitcoin network fees for locking/refunding, and suffers opportunity cost.
By verifying the reserve proof in the quote header, the eigenwallet client automatically filters out ghost or underfunded orders before any Bitcoin transaction is generated or broadcast.
Verification Flow inside Eigenwallet
Quote Inspection: When you browse the View Offers tab inside eigenwallet, the client parses the maker's attached reserve proof parameter.Local Monero Daemon Check: The client queries a Monero node to verify that the key images referenced in the proof remain unspent on-chain.Execution Gate: If the proof is valid and covers the trade size, the client flags the maker as Verified / Funded and permits trade initiation. If the signature is missing or invalid, eigenwallet flags the offer or blocks trade execution to keep your Bitcoin liquid.

title: What steps can I take if a market maker mistakenly withholds my anti-spam deposit on eigenwallet?
subTitle:
#monerofalls13%ondelistings 
If a market maker mistakenly or prematurely withholds your anti-spam deposit after an aborted or stalled trade on eigenwallet, your funds are safe from theft—the protocol design guarantees that the maker cannot receive or profit from your deposit.
To resolve the situation and request a release or document the issue, follow these step-by-step actions:
Step 1: Verify the 30-Minute Timelock Status
Before reaching out, check whether the deposit is actually withheld or simply pending:
Open the History / Swaps tab inside eigenwallet.Locate the failed or refunded trade ID.Check the status indicator:Pending Timelock: The anti-spam mechanism holds the deposit (typically 2% to 5%) in script lock for ~30 minutes following a partial refund. Once this window expires without manual intervention, many automated makers automatically release the remaining Bitcoin.Withheld: If 30+ minutes have passed and the status explicitly changes to Withheld, move to Step 2.
Step 2: Contact the Market Maker Directly
Market makers on eigenwallet manage their own automated software and node policies. Because trades are non-custodial and run without a central escrow agent, issuing a deposit release requires a manual signature from the maker's node.
Copy Swap Identifiers: Copy the Swap ID, your Bitcoin refund transaction hash, and your Monero deposit address from the swap summary panel.Find Maker Contact Info: Check the maker's profile tag from the order book offer listing or look up their handle on the official community channels:Matrix / Element: #eigenwallet:matrix.org (or #unstoppableswap:matrix.org)Discord: Official eigenwallet Community ServerMonero Town / Forum Threads: Maker listing posts on Matrix or BitcointalkSubmit a Release Request: Send a message providing your Swap ID and explaining why the swap aborted (e.g., unexpected local Internet disconnect, software crash, or RPC synchronization error). Honest makers routinely grant mercy releases for non-malicious connectivity issues.
Step 3: Flag or Report Uncooperative Makers
If a maker refuses to release an mistakenly withheld deposit or goes completely unresponsive:
File an On-Chain / UI Bug Report: Open an issue on the official [eigenwallet GitHub Repository](https://github.com/eigenwallet) under the protocol issue tracker. Include non-sensitive transaction hashes and swap logs so maintainers can audit whether a software edge case triggered a false-positive griefer flag.Community Blacklisting: Report bad-faith makers in the #eigenwallet community Matrix channel. The community and community-run rendezvous points track maker reliability; makers who routinely punish honest swappers are flagged on order book aggregators and community listing sites.
Step 4: Verify How to Prevent Future Flags
To avoid triggering automated anti-griefer thresholds on subsequent trades:
Maintain Stable Connectivity: Never close eigenwallet or disconnect from the Tor network while a swap is actively confirming on-chain.Review Anti-Spam Ratios: Before starting a swap, examine the maker's anti-spam lock ratio on the offer details screen. Choose makers with lower deposit requirements if your local connection is prone to dropping.

title: Explain how the anti-spam deposit mechanism works in eigenwallet during atomic swaps.
subTitle:
#monerofalls13%ondelistings 
The anti-spam deposit mechanism in eigenwallet (formerly UnstoppableSwap) solves a critical vulnerability inherent to non-custodial BTC to XMR atomic swaps: asymmetric free-option and griefing attacks against market makers.
The Problem It Solves
Because Monero lacks native smart-contract timelocks, the protocol requires the Maker to lock XMR first after watching the Taker lock BTC.
Without an anti-spam deposit, a malicious Taker (or a competing market maker) could lock up a Maker’s Monero liquidity for hours at virtually zero cost. The attacker could simply abandon or force-refund the trade whenever:
The price shifted unfavorably during the swap execution (using atomic swaps as a free option).They wanted to launch a Denial-of-Service (DoS) attack to drain the Maker's available capital pool and disrupt their service.
How the Anti-Spam Deposit Works
When selecting an offer, a Maker can set an anti-spam lock ratio (typically ~2% to 5% of the swap value).

Trade Commitment & Selection: The Taker selects an offer displaying an anti-spam ratio (e.g., 2% deposit = guaranteed 98% instant refund floor).Normal / Successful Swap (Zero Cost): If the swap completes as intended, the Taker gets 100% of their Monero, the Maker redeems 100% of the locked Bitcoin, and no deposit is forfeited.Partial Refund on Stalled Swaps: If a swap fails or is aborted by the Taker, the initial refund transaction returns only the bulk balance (e.g., 95%–98% of the deposited BTC) back to the Taker immediately. The remaining 2%–5% stays temporarily locked.Maker Discretion (Release vs. Withhold):Honest Takers (Release): After a short timelock (typically ~30 minutes), the Maker releases the remaining deposit back to the Taker if the failure was caused by unintended connectivity loss or network delays.Griefers (Withheld/Burned): If the Maker detects malicious behavior or price manipulation, the Maker can choose to withhold the deposit.
Crucial Security Invariant: Non-Profit for Makers
A critical aspect of the eigenwallet anti-spam mechanism is that the Maker receives $0 from a withheld deposit.
Withheld funds remain locked in an unspendable Bitcoin script path (effectively burning or permanently locking the collateral).Why this matters: Because the Maker cannot profit from a canceled swap, they have no financial incentive to maliciously cause swaps to fail just to steal the Taker's deposit. It serves purely as a deterrent against griefer spam.

title: What are the technical steps and setup to run a desktop BTC to XMR atomic swap using eigenwallet?
subTitle:
#monerofalls13%ondelistings 
Executing a decentralized BTC to XMR atomic swap using eigenwallet (formerly UnstoppableSwap) allows you to exchange Bitcoin for Monero fully peer-to-peer, without intermediaries, accounts, or centralized exchange custody.
In this setup, you act as the Taker (providing BTC) and trade directly with a Maker (providing XMR) via cryptographic smart locks on both chains.
Prerequisites Before You Begin
Eigenwallet Client: Download and install the latest desktop release of eigenwallet for your operating system (Windows, macOS, or Linux).Bitcoin Funds: Ensure you have enough BTC in your wallet to cover the minimum swap amount set by makers (typically around 0.0003 BTC to 0.003+ BTC, plus standard Bitcoin network fees).Monero Receiving Address: Have a native XMR address ready (starting with 4 for a main address or 8 for a subaddress) to receive your swapped funds. Generating a fresh subaddress for each trade protects your privacy hygiene.
Technical Setup & Swap Steps
Step 1: Deposit Bitcoin into Eigenwallet
Launch eigenwallet on your desktop.Navigate to the internal self-custodial wallet page to view your generated Bitcoin deposit address (or scan the provided QR code).Transfer the total BTC amount you intend to swap into this internal wallet.Note: Eigenwallet swaps the full available BTC balance deposited in that session to streamline counterparty key derivation. Only deposit what you plan to exchange.
Step 2: Browse & Select a Swap Offer
Go to the Swap tab and click View Offers.Review the live order book from connected market makers. Filter through:Markup / Spread: The percentage over spot rate charged by the maker (e.g., +2% to +5%).Min / Max Limits: Ensure your deposited BTC falls within the maker's limits.Anti-Spam Lock Ratio: A small collateral percentage (usually ~2%) temporarily held to prevent bad-faith trade locking, which is fully returned upon standard swap completion.Click Select on your chosen offer.
Step 3: Configure Destination & Confirm Terms
Input your external XMR Receiving Address.Review the quote lock details:Amount of BTC sentExact amount of XMR expectedBitcoin network transaction feeClick Confirm Swap to broadcast the trade lock parameters.
Protocol Execution (Automatic 4-Stage Flow)
Once confirmed, eigenwallet executes the underlying cryptographic swap automatically through four automated phases:

Locking Bitcoin: Your client constructs a 2-of-2 multisig script transaction locking your BTC into an on-chain address.Maker Locks Monero: The maker observes your Bitcoin lock transaction, constructs a 2-of-2 Monero address, and locks their XMR inside.Maker Redeems Bitcoin: The maker claims the locked BTC by broadcasting a signature encumbered with an Adaptor Signature.Redeeming Monero: By sweeping the BTC on-chain, the maker automatically reveals their secret key component. Your eigenwallet client parses this key from the public Bitcoin blockchain, assembles the full Monero spend key, and sweeps the XMR directly into your Monero address.
Total trade time usually ranges between 30 to 60 minutes, depending on Bitcoin block confirmation speed.
Timelocks & Safety Nets
If a counterparty disconnects or stalls, eigenwallet enforces cryptographic timelocks so your funds remain secure:
Cancel Timelock (~5 Hours / 30 BTC Blocks): If the maker fails to complete their side of the trade, a cancel transaction becomes available.Refund Window (~24 Hours / 144 BTC Blocks): Once the cancel transaction is published, you have a 24-hour window to execute the Refund Transaction to reclaim your Bitcoin back into your wallet.

title: How do decentralized BTC to XMR atomic swaps work step by step?
subTitle:
#monerofalls13%ondelistings 
A decentralized Bitcoin (BTC) to Monero (XMR) atomic swap allows two parties to exchange BTC for XMR trustlessly, without using a central exchange, an escrow agent, or revealing private identities.
The core challenge in swapping BTC for XMR is asymmetric smart-contract support: Bitcoin supports Hash Time-Locked Contracts (HTLCs), whereas Monero does not have a scripting language to support standard smart contracts.
To bypass this, modern protocols (like the Farcaster/COMIT specification and BasicSwap DEX) use Adaptor Signatures (One-Time Verifiable Encrypted Signatures) paired with a 2-of-2 multisig address on Monero.
Step-by-Step Execution Flow
Assume Bob has BTC and wants XMR, while Alice has XMR and wants BTC.
Step 1: Off-Chain Parameter & Key Exchange
Bob and Alice connect via a peer-to-peer network or atomic swap client (such as Haveno, BasicSwap, or UnstoppableSwap).They exchange public keys and create joint control parameters for both blockchains.Alice split-generates a joint 2-of-2 Monero lock address with Bob.Bob constructs a 2-of-2 Bitcoin multisig address requiring signatures from both Alice and Bob.
Step 2: Alice Locks the Monero (XMR)
Alice deposits her XMR into the joint 2-of-2 Monero address on-chain.Because Monero lacks time-locked smart contracts, Alice must lock her funds first. She retains protection because the XMR cannot be spent by Bob without her cryptographic signature half.
Step 3: Bob Locks the Bitcoin (BTC)
Once Bob sees Alice’s XMR lock transaction confirmed on the Monero blockchain, Bob locks his BTC into the 2-of-2 Bitcoin multisig address.The Bitcoin output is spending-encumbered by two paths:Claim Path (Alice): Locked until Alice reveals an adaptor signature.Refund Path (Bob): A time-lock ($T_1$) parameter. If Alice abandons the trade, Bob can reclaim his BTC after $T_1$ expires.
Step 4: Alice Claims the Bitcoin
To claim the BTC from Bob’s script address, Alice must publish her spending signature to the Bitcoin network.This signature is cryptographically bound (via Adaptor Signatures) to her private key component for the Monero 2-of-2 address.By broadcasting her transaction to sweep the BTC to her wallet, Alice's signature is made public on the Bitcoin blockchain.
Step 5: Bob Extrapolates Key & Claims Monero
Bob observes Alice’s sweep transaction on the public Bitcoin blockchain.Bob extracts the secret key component revealed inside Alice's Bitcoin signature.Bob combines that revealed secret with his own key half to complete the full private spend key for the 2-of-2 Monero address.Bob sweeps the XMR directly into his personal Monero wallet.
Fallbacks & Security Features
No Counterparty Risk: Neither user ever hands control of their funds to the other or to a third party. The crypto-math guarantees that either both trades settle or both sides receive their initial funds back.Timelocks & Cancel Safety: If Alice locks her XMR and Bob fails to lock his BTC, Alice can recover her funds after a specified safety duration ($T_2$) using a penalty/cancel signature protocol. If Bob locks BTC and Alice stops responding, Bob sweeps his BTC back via timelock $T_1$.Unlinkable Transactions: On the Monero side, standard ring signatures and stealth addresses shield the swap outputs. The adaptor signature mechanism ensures that no on-chain data links the Bitcoin transaction directly to the Monero lock transaction.

ETH upgrade buzz is building｜Smart wallet billing has blind spots｜Wait for 1705 confirmation

My stance is to watch cautiously, not chase ETH just because the “storage fee adjustment is retained.” The trending topic on Binance Square is #EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeChange, with discussion rising from 191 in the previous round to 208. This reflects increased attention; it does not mean the upgrade has gone live or that prices are certain to rise. Ethereum’s official EIP-8037 page is still marked Last Call. The November 26 core developer meeting notes describe a rough consensus to continue advancing the existing proposal, but testing and formal procedures are still needed. This cannot be treated as something already implemented on mainnet.

What concerns me more this time is the smart wallet bill that ordinary holders can easily overlook. EIP-8037 separates execution Gas from the Gas used to create new on-chain state, and introduces a “state Gas reserve.” The proposal’s security section explicitly warns that the GAS opcode only sees execution Gas and cannot directly see the reserve. When estimating subcall costs using the difference between two calls to gasleft(), as ERC-4337 EntryPoint does, state costs paid from the reserve may not be accurately allocated across individual user operations. Different operations in a bundled transaction will also share the reserve, so state refunds and charges may offset one another. The proposal requires bundlers and EntryPoint to explicitly account for state Gas. This concerns compatibility and billing risks under the proposed rules; it is not a wallet incident that has already occurred, nor does it imply that all ETH transfers will suddenly become more expensive.

How might this affect the market? In the short term, it mainly affects developer testing, wallet fee quotes, and expectations for application deployment—not immediate buying pressure in the ETH spot market. If subsequent tests show that major smart wallets can reliably allocate fees, upgrade uncertainty will ease; if compatibility issues persist, the growing buzz could first bring volatility. Farside’s complete November 25 ETH spot fund table shows net outflows of $68.5 million. The November 27 column is still blank, so it cannot be described as zero inflows that day. Kraken ETH/USD was around $1,664 at the time of writing, with a rolling open around $1,688 and a range of $1,632–$1,752; the price remains below the open, showing no sign that the hot topic has reversed the weakness.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now. I would only consider a small, unleveraged spot long, capped at 0.15% of total capital. First, wait for a four-hour close above $1,705, then enter only if a retest of $1,695–$1,705 holds and order-book liquidity remains normal. Take half off at $1,735 and close the rest at $1,770. Set a stop-loss below $1,678; if price breaks below $1,632 before entry, cancel the plan. If, after breaking above the level, a four-hour candle closes back below $1,695, exit manually even if the stop-loss has not been hit. A clear, serious compatibility failure in EIP testing, or newly disclosed ETF flows weakening alongside the price, would also invalidate this conditional bullish plan. If none of these conditions trigger, remain in cash; don’t write the plan as if a trade has been executed.

subTitle:
#EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeChange #EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeCheap
The Ethereum developer ecosystem is moving forward with its next core transformation, as software client teams reached a "rough consensus" on November 26, 2026, to retain the controversial EIP-8037 storage-fee changes in the upcoming Glamsterdam hard fork.
Originally planned for an earlier launch, Glamsterdam's Hoodi testnet deployment has been scheduled for December 15, 2026, at 19:12 UTC—marking the final public sandbox trial before the upgrade eventually marches toward mainnet, which developers aim to target as early as late January or February 2027 to allow applications more preparation time.
📊 Deep Dive on EIP-8037 & The Technical Repricing:
Storage vs. Execution Decoupling: In a push to enhance scaling and restrain database bloat as transaction concurrency increases, EIP-8037 establishes separate accounting for state creation. It charges storage costs out of their own dedicated reservoir rather than forcing them to directly compete with raw computational logic for standard transaction gas.
New Baselines & Growth Targets: The proposal introduces a standard cost of 32,000 gas units for state-creation operations and 183,600 gas units for smart contract creation. This repricing targets a sustainable database growth rate of roughly 120 GiB per year.
The Compatibility Conflict: Security audit giant ChainSecurity previously flagged over 200 potential compatibility issues—with 24 identified as requiring explicit upgrades or fund-migration procedures. Over 50 companies were consulted regarding these concerns. Contract configurations that assume fixed gas boundaries or limited state costs risk execution failures if the calls are not updated to handle the new state fee structure.
💡 Market Context & Outlook:
Ethereum's co-founder Vitalik Buterin has actively defended these adjustments, pointing out that raising storage fees is necessary to restrict state bloat and unblock a pathway toward significantly higher base-layer gas limit expansions in the future. While the shift to parallel processing (EIP-7928) and in-protocol Proposer-Builder Separation (ePBS, EIP-7732) are massively bullish for scale, the repricing of new state data is a necessary speedbump to keep node hardware requirements democratized. Mainnet ETH transfers may see gas optimization, but projects that rely heavily on permanent state-writing will face significantly higher upfront barriers. As a safety measure against major compatibility failures, teams are being given ample runway to test their projects. Keep an eye on testnet activity over December to gauge mainnet preparedness—manage risk tightly!
👇 Will the permanent storage fee restructure help secure Ethereum's decentralization, or will the smart-contract friction drive more capital toward layer-2 chains like Arbitrum and Base? Share your views below! 👇

📰 贝莱德高管公开喊话24/7全天候金融，为什么是在Tokenized资产大会上说？到底想干什么？

据 CryptoBriefing 报道，贝莱德的 Maxwell Stein 在 LINK:NYC 大会上公开为「24/7 全天候金融」站台，核心观点是：全球市场应该实现不间断交易，而这需要强大的基础设施和流动性方案来支撑，资产代币化是绕不开的一环。

先说背景数字：当下 BTC 报 $59,773.25（24h -1.62%），ETH 报 $1,666.85（24h -2.20%），市场情绪偏弱，这条消息算是弱市里的一点长期叙事燃料。

一句话翻译：全球最大资管公司的人跑来加密行业大会说「传统金融的开闭市制度该淘汰了」，这不是客套，是在给代币化资产铺路。

为什么这条新闻重要？

说白了，传统市场一天只开几个小时，周末和节假日完全停摆，而加密市场365天24小时不停机。贝莱德不是第一次表这个态——他们的 BTC ETF 和代币化基金（BUIDL）早就落地了，这次高管亲自出面讲「全天候金融」，本质上是把之前的产品动作升级成了理念层面的公开输出。

关键在于说话的场合：LINK:NYC 是加密行业的主场。贝莱德选择在这里讲这个话题，等于承认一件事——要做全天候金融，现有的加密基础设施（公链、稳定币结算、代币化标准）是最现成的底座。传统金融机构不再是「来币圈淘金」，而是「来币圈找水电煤」。

这件事在行业周期里的位置也值得琢磨：现在价格层面冷冷清清，但机构侧的基础设施建设一直在推进。历史上每一轮牛市的铺垫期都是这样——价格先躺平，管道先铺好。

对市场的影响

短期看，这就是一条情绪层面的消息，不会改变 BTC 和 ETH 的短线走势，弱市里该跌还是跌。

中期看，影响链路是这样的：贝莱德等巨头持续推动资产代币化 → 传统资产（债券、基金、 possibly 股票）上链 → 链上结算需求上升 → 稳定币和底层公链的链上活动受益 → ETH 作为主要结算层是间接受益方之一。这条链路每一步都有不确定性，但方向上和贝莱德过去两年的实际动作是一致的。

参考历史：2024 年 ETF 获批前，也是先有贝莱德高层的多次公开表态，再有资金实际流入。高管理念输出往往是资金动作的前奏，但不等于必然兑现。

💡 我的看法：这是一条「长期利好叙事、短期无关行情」的典型消息。现在市场报价 ETH $1,666.85、BTC $59,773.25，情绪面没有任何变化，别因为一句行业大佬的发言就上头。我自己的仓位没什么调整，也就是把这条记在「机构管道继续铺设」的观察清单里。判断有六成把握，剩下四成交给市场，说错轻喷。

如果贝莱德后续半年内没有实际的代币化产品扩容动作，这条「全天候金融」叙事就可以当作纯口号处理。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold on to a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking to themselves: “If it just gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Understand this: that thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only cares about supply and demand right now.

Once you start holding onto a losing position, you automatically seek out good news and block out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to feel that
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned through more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to follow: before entering a trade, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
no longer holds,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your position, and only then can you see clearly.

【ETH upgrade: the bigger the rally, the more expensive trading gets?】

A lot of people think an upgrade means “good news arrives, and the price surges.” That’s backwards. Glamsterdam changes how Gas is priced, like a market resetting its stall fees: whether traders, dApps, or developers end up paying more depends on whether the new rules work in practice.

The testnet upgrade is scheduled for December 15, and developers will deploy the controversial Gas changes as-is. It was postponed once in October over concerns that Gas changes could disrupt existing smart contracts.

In practice, the groups directly affected are wallet providers, dApps, contract operators, and traders. The business logic is simple: it’s not “upgrade and make money.” The question is whether real demand will remain under the new costs, and whether developers will be willing to keep building.

ETH is down 2% over 24 hours but up 3.9% over seven days, with trading volume unusually high; the Fear and Greed Index is just 12. The market seems to be betting on a major move, but I’m more concerned about whether the testnet will run into trouble again. An upgrade doesn’t guarantee a price rise; stability and real-world adoption are what count.

Remember: first see whether the technology can be rolled out safely, then see who actually benefits financially. Are you itching to jump in—chase the rally or wait for the testnet to run smoothly?

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s the Price of Admission to Your Next Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they treat it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more often right, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most steady-handed traders I’ve seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand shakes as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

Ethereum developers have scheduled the final public test of Glamsterdam, the next major upgrade, for December 15.

On November 26, Ethereum core developers met and decided to proceed with the upgrade as currently planned. It will first go live on the final public testnet, Hoodi, on December 15 at 19:12 UTC (3:12 a.m. on December 16 in UTC+8). The test was originally scheduled for October 26, but was postponed after a security firm warned that the new fee rules could cause problems for some contracts already in operation. Another testnet, Sepolia, had already run the upgrade in October. No date has been set yet for the mainnet launch.

The change drawing the most attention is a substantial increase in fees for creating new data on-chain, which will be charged separately. Reports say creating a new account will cost about seven times as much in fees as it does now, while deploying a large contract will cost about eight times as much. Although some have raised concerns that certain older contracts could fail partway through, developers have decided to proceed with the current plan. One report also said that a developer estimated around 15,000 existing contracts could be affected.

For now, this is not the mainnet launch, but only the final public dress rehearsal. The teams involved need to fix any potential issues before the test.

11月26日，以太坊核心开发者开会决定，这次升级按现有方案继续推进，并在12月15日19:12（世界协调时，东八区是16日凌晨3:12）先在最后的公开测试网Hoodi上线。这次测试原本订在10月26日，后来有安全机构提醒，新的手续费规则可能让一些已经在运行的合约出问题，因而推迟。另一个测试网Sepolia已经在10月先跑过了。主网什么时候上线，目前还没有确定日期。

这次最受关注的改动，是大幅提高在链上新建数据的费用，而且会单独计费。有报道说，新建一个账户大约要花掉现在约7倍的手续费，部署一份较大的合约大约是现在的8倍。尽管有人担心部分老合约会因此中途失败，开发者还是决定按原方案推进。另有报道称，有开发者估计大约1.5万个已有合约可能受到影响。

对大家来说，这还不是主网上线，只是最后一轮公开彩排。相关团队需要在测试前，把可能出问题的地方改好。

先看盘（币安现货数据）：$BTC 约 59,890 美元，24 小时约 -1.4%；#ETH 约 1,671 美元，约 -2.1%；ZEC 约 743 美元，24 小时约 +3.7%，算是今晚少数翻红的。恐慌贪婪指数 12，极度恐慌。

ZEC 这个月其实很不好过，人家整理了几条：
1）据多家报道，ZEC 11 月累计跌幅超过 40%，一度回到 700 美元附近，交易员普遍盯着 670–700 这一带支撑；
2）11 月 26 日，Zcash 开发团队建议关闭 2018 年上线的 Sapling 隐私池的新存入，把资金迁到更新的 Ironwood 池。理由是 Sapling 用的密码学在理论上存在量子计算风险，目前并没有已知漏洞，Sapling 的取出仍然开放；据报道 Sapling 里还有约 37.6 万–40 万枚 ZEC，Ironwood 已承载约 85% 的屏蔽资金；
3）同一周，Gemini 宣布支持向 Ironwood 池的屏蔽存款，加上之前已开放的屏蔽提现，成为首家两头都支持的大型交易所（链上隐私，交易所这边身份验证照旧）。

人家的看法（哼，才不是想躲进隐私池里藏小鱼干）：
· 「主动迁移」是偏防御的安全升级，短期可能带来情绪波动，但不等于币被攻破了，别被标题吓到；
· 今晚的反弹放在月线 -40% 的背景下看，更像超跌后的喘口气，单日翻红说明不了趋势；
· 隐私类资产波动和监管不确定性都更大，仓位要比主流币更克制。

title: Ethereum Keeps Glamsterdam Storage Fee Changes: Could 15,000 Smart Contracts Be at Risk?
subTitle:
Ethereum developers have reached an important decision on the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade: the controversial storage-fee changes will remain in the planned specifications despite concerns about their impact on existing smart contracts.
The decision could shape Ethereum's long-term scalability, but it also creates a race for developers whose applications may not work as expected under the new fee structure.
What Exactly Did Developers Decide?
On November 26, Ethereum core developers reached a rough consensus to proceed with the current Glamsterdam specifications, including EIP-8037.
The proposal introduces a separate charge for creating permanent data on Ethereum, such as deploying smart contracts or adding new storage records.
Under the proposed rules, the storage-related base cost of deploying a new contract would rise from 32,000 to 183,600 gas, before additional code-storage and execution costs.
The goal is to make applications pay more accurately for the long-term storage burden they create for Ethereum nodes.
Why Are Developers Concerned?
The problem is not simply that some operations will become more expensive.
Many existing smart contracts were developed around the old gas-cost assumptions. If an application has a fixed gas allowance when calling another contract, the new pricing rules could cause that transaction to run out of gas and fail.
Ethereum Foundation developer Marius van der Wijden estimated that as many as 15,000 contracts could be exposed to this risk out of approximately 90 million contracts on the network.
Security reviews have also identified around 200 specific trouble spots. Most can reportedly be addressed through configuration changes, while 24 require contract upgrades or migration to replacement applications.
This does not mean 15,000 contracts are confirmed to be broken. It means they may need testing and, in some cases, corrective action.
What Happens Next?
The final public test is scheduled for December 15 on Ethereum's Hoodi testnet.
Affected development teams have a limited window to identify compatibility issues and fix the most serious problems before the upgrade progresses further.
A mainnet activation date has not yet been officially announced.
Is This Bullish or Bearish for ETH?
The answer is not straightforward.
Potential long-term benefits:
Better accounting for permanent data storage.More sustainable growth of Ethereum's state database.A stronger foundation for increasing network capacity.Improved alignment between network resource usage and fees.
Potential short-term challenges:
Higher costs for certain smart-contract operations.Compatibility work for existing applications.Possible transaction failures in contracts that are not updated.Uncertainty until testing and audits are completed.
Importantly, this change does not automatically mean that ordinary ETH transfers will become more expensive. Glamsterdam includes separate proposals affecting transaction costs, and the overall impact depends on the type of operation.
Final Thoughts
Ethereum is trying to solve a difficult problem: how to increase network capacity without allowing its underlying database to grow beyond what ordinary node operators can reasonably maintain.
Keeping the storage-fee changes may support that long-term objective, but developers must address compatibility risks before deployment.
For ETH investors, this is a major network-development story, not an automatic buy or sell signal.
Do you think Ethereum should prioritize long-term network sustainability even if some existing smart contracts need expensive updates?

ETH Upgrade in Focus｜Developer Team Supports Current Draft, but That Doesn’t Mean Applications Are Unaffected｜Confirmation Needed Above 1705

My view is to continue treating the Ethereum upgrade as an engineering event that still needs verification, rather than treating the buzz around it as a buy signal. Binance Square’s #EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeChange is still trending. On November 25, Ethlabs publicly stated on the Ethereum developers’ forum that it recommends proceeding with Glamsterdam as currently proposed, while acknowledging that the contract compatibility issues caused by EIP-8037 are real. Minutes from the November 26 core developers’ meeting record a rough consensus among execution-layer teams to retain the current specifications. The former is the assessment of a team involved in the analysis; the latter is the outcome of a meeting discussion. Neither should be presented as “the mainnet has upgraded and all applications are compatible.” The EIP website still lists it as being in Last Call and under peer review.

The risk I’m focused on this time isn’t a vague rise or fall in gas prices, but assumptions that older contracts make about the execution environment. Ethlabs notes that repricing state creation will affect deployed contracts that hard-code gas costs; the new state gas reserve mechanism may also make certain development patterns involving calls to untrusted contracts and try/catch harder to handle. They believe the number of affected projects is limited and that many issues can be mitigated, but that is their assessment—not proof that the entire ecosystem has been fully validated. For traders, what really matters is whether application teams publish test and migration results, whether clients are released on schedule, and whether the testnet runs reliably.

The stated goal of EIP-8037 is to curb state growth and make room for a higher block gas limit. It adjusts the cost of creating state, such as creating accounts, deploying code, and adding new storage slots, and introduces separate metering. It cannot be summed up as every ETH transfer becoming proportionally more expensive, nor does it imply that ETH burn will immediately double. If application teams need to modify their code for compatibility, development and audit costs could rise in the short term; if scaling succeeds over the long term, on-chain capacity could benefit. Both scenarios depend on real deployment and usage data. We shouldn’t use future scenarios to assign certain gains to the current price.

The market has yet to show clear approval. Kraken ETH/USD is around $1,670.58, with a rolling 24-hour open of $1,687.68, low of $1,632.16, and high of $1,752.33; the current price remains below the open. Farside’s November 27 ETH fund products section is not yet fully populated, so the automated total should not be treated as confirmed zero flows; the complete November 25 record shows net outflows of $68.5 million. Prices, fund flows, and upgrade discussions are all changing at once, and I can’t prove that a move in this particular hour was caused by any single developer comment. 1705 is my threshold for watching whether short-term buying returns; around 1632 is the structural warning line below.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only a leveraged-free spot long. I’d enter a small test position using no more than 0.15% of my total capital only if a four-hour candle closes and holds above 1705, followed by a pullback that holds between 1695 and 1705. I’d first target 1735 and sell half there, then close the rest at 1770. I’d place a stop-loss at 1678 after entry; if the four-hour price closes back below 1690, I’d also exit manually. If the price breaks below 1632 before those conditions trigger, this long setup is invalidated. If official testing reveals a major compatibility failure or the upgrade scope is reopened for discussion, I’ll cancel the plan first, then review the client and project announcements. For me, being able to exit a position matters more than getting a grand narrative right.

ETH升级热题｜开发团队支持现稿不等于应用无损｜1705上方再确认

我的态度是继续把以太坊升级当作待验证的工程事件，不把讨论热度当成买点。币安广场#EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeChange仍在热门榜。11月25日Ethlabs在以太坊开发者论坛公开表态，建议Glamsterdam按现有方案推进，同时承认EIP-8037带来的合约兼容问题是真实的；11月26日核心开发者会议纪要记载，执行层团队对保留当前规范形成了粗略共识。前者是参与分析团队的判断，后者是会议讨论结果，都不能写成「主网已升级、所有应用已适配」。EIP官网仍标注Last Call和同行审查中。

这次我关注的风险不是笼统的Gas涨跌，而是旧合约对执行环境的假设。Ethlabs指出，状态创建重新计价会影响把Gas成本写死的已部署合约；新的状态Gas储备机制还会让某些涉及不可信合约调用和try/catch的开发模式更难处理。他们认为受影响项目数量有限、很多可以缓解，但这是其评估，并不等于全生态已经验证完毕。对交易者而言，真正该盯的是应用方是否公布测试和迁移结果、客户端是否按计划发布，以及测试网能否稳定运行。

EIP-8037原文的目标是抑制状态增长，为更高区块Gas上限留空间。它调整的是创建账户、部署代码和新存储槽等状态创建成本，还引入独立计量；不能概括成每一笔ETH转账都会同幅涨价，也不能推导出ETH销毁马上翻倍。若应用方因兼容性需要改代码，短期可能增加开发和审计成本；若长期扩容顺利，链上容量可能受益。这两条路径都要等待真实上线与使用数据，不能现在拿未来情景去给现价贴确定收益。

市场尚未给出明确认可。查询Kraken ETH/USD约1670.58美元，滚动24小时开盘1687.68、低点1632.16、高点1752.33，现价仍低于开盘。Farside的11月27日ETH基金产品栏尚未填齐，自动总计不能当作已确认的零流量；11月25日完整记录为净流出6850万美元。价格、基金流向和升级讨论同时变化，我无法证明这一小时的波动由某一句开发者发言造成。1705是我观察短线买盘是否恢复的门槛，1632附近是下方结构警戒线。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货试多。只有四小时收盘站稳1705，随后回踩1695至1705守住，我才用总资金最多0.15%试单；先看1735，触及减半，余仓到1770全部平仓。入场后跌破1678止损；若四小时重新收回1690下方，也主动平仓。触发之前先跌破1632，这套多头计划直接作废。若官方测试出现重大兼容故障或升级范围重新讨论，我会先取消计划，再读客户端和项目公告。对我来说，能退出的仓位比看对宏大叙事更重要。

#EthereumGlamsterdamKeepsStorageFeeChange #ETH

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Position Rolling: Fortune Through Risk, or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Position rolling has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital and several times leverage to ride a big trend, roll it over a few times
and multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about the part they don’t tell you.

【What position rolling does】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you treat them as risk capital for a new position and keep opening trades,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding is incredible; once the trend stops, those unrealized gains
can go from dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of position rolling is “getting it right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

一、以太坊ETH市场深度分析：跌破关键支撑但链上活动活跃

截至北京时间十一月二十八日凌晨，以太坊报价一千六百六十五美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点六。价格从一千七百二十四美元的高位大幅下挫至一千六百五十二美元的日内低点，随后反弹至一千六百七十二美元附近，最终回落至一千六百六十五美元一线窄幅整理。整体走势弱于比特币，跌幅更大。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统全面空头排列。七日移动均线一千六百八十三美元，二十五日均线一千七百零七美元，九十九日均线一千六百九十二美元，价格运行在所有均线下方。指数移动均线同样如此，七日指数均线一千六百八十二美元，二十五日指数均线一千七百美元，九十九日指数均线一千六百九十八美元，形成层层阻力。

布林带指标显示上轨一千七百六十三美元，中轨一千七百零九美元，下轨一千六百五十四美元。价格在下轨附近运行，通道有继续扩张的趋势，表明波动性加大且方向偏空。

MACD指标持续走弱，DIF线为负七点八四，DEA线为零点二三，柱状图为负八点零七，空头动能仍在释放但力度略有收敛。RSI六周期数值为二十七点一零，深度超卖区域，十二周期RSI为三十三点六八，二十四周期RSI为四十一三点三八，与比特币类似呈现短周期极端超卖的状态。KDJ指标中K值三十二点四七，D值三十二点二九，J值三十二点八二，三线在低位高度粘合，随时可能选择方向突破。威廉指标负七十二点一九处于超卖区间，随机RSI为十九点二四处于极低位置。

技术因子统计显示，十五个因子中十个看多，五个看空，没有中性信号，做多比例同样为百分之六十六点六七。综合指标发出空头信号，但整体胜率高达百分之八十点八五，其中做多胜率为百分之九十一点六七，做空胜率为百分之六十九点五七，这意味着一旦趋势反转，做多的成功概率非常高。

三、市场情绪分析

Bio Protocol is changing its Launchpad rules: projects will have to deliver research results before they get their money.

According to ChainCatcher, Bio Protocol co-founder Paul Kohlhaas announced three new features on X: First, funds will be released in tranches tied to research milestones—no results, no full payout. Second, small grants will be available for individual experiments, with one grant per experiment. Third, a new channel will let token holders voluntarily apply for equity in companies that hold relevant IP.

Put simply, Launchpads used to raise money and then leave everyone to get on with it. Now they’re moving to an “approval-based” model: the platform holds the funds and releases them only when milestones are met.

Bio has already launched 18 projects and raised around $26 million. That’s not a huge scale, but it puts the project among the leaders in the DeSci niche.

Market impact
- Short term: This could provide a sentiment boost for DeSci. Projects in the Bio ecosystem will come under renewed scrutiny: those with genuine research progress may benefit, while projects that are all talk will face more pressure. The broader crypto market is weak today, with BTC at $59,840 and ETH at $1,667.84, both down. This kind of mechanism innovation is unlikely to trigger a major capital response in the short term.

- Medium term: This could be a turning point for DeSci. Frankly, the sector’s biggest problem over the past year has been that “scientists tell stories, investors pay up, and results remain nowhere in sight.” Tying funding to milestones and opening an equity application channel for token holders effectively brings the logic of VC due diligence on-chain. If it works, other Launchpads will likely follow suit, giving DeSci a chance to compete for capital with narratives like RWA and AI.

In a nutshell: Before, projects got the money first and did the work later. Now they have to do the work to get paid—DeSci is choosing to put itself on a tighter leash.

Cautiously neutral. The mechanism is heading in the right direction and could weed out some projects that exist purely to issue tokens, making it a long-term positive for the Bio ecosystem. Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade raises an important question: should storage fees stay the same, or does Ethereum need a different approach?

Ethereum’s storage economics are more important than they might seem. Every smart contract, token balance, and piece of persistent on-chain data contributes to the network’s state, which nodes must maintain and manage.

Keeping the existing approach could provide continuity for developers and avoid introducing additional complexity. However, changing the fee structure could potentially improve incentives, make storage usage more efficient, and help address Ethereum’s growing state-management challenges.

There is a trade-off, though. Higher or differently structured storage costs could affect smart contract developers, dApps, and users. Any changes would need careful consideration to avoid making Ethereum less accessible.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend right and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in right away and adding all your unrealized profits is a recipe for ending up on the liquidation list.
A common one. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【The principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. This keeps your average cost weighted toward lower levels, so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at high levels. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, your trading goes off the rails.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Afford Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
The account only draws down 20%, and a few winning trades can get it back. By contrast, if you go all in each time and lose 30%,
Three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%”; it’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.
